tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal rdo rje gur las gsungs pa'i mkha' 'gro lnga rigs bsdus pa'i sgrub dkyil drug bcud snying po bdun pa bzhugs so// na mo gu ru pañtsa ḍā ki nī ye/ bde stong zung 'jug mkha' khyab sku/ /gang 'dul der ston 'gro ba'i mgon/ /ye shes lnga ldan rigs bsdus kyi/ /dkyil 'khor lhar 'dud cho ga bri/ /zhes mchod brjod dam bca' nyung ngu sngon du btang nas/ de la 'dir dpal kyai rdo rje'i bshad rgyud thun mong min pa rdo rje gur rigs bsdus kyi ras bris la brten pa'i sgrub dkyil nag 'gros bklag chog go bde'i ngag gis bshad na/ sta gon dang dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po ni/ sa phyogs gtsang zhing dben par phyag dar dang rkyang nul bya/ bla bre dang yol ba la sogs pa'i rgyan dgram/ bris sku dang lugs ma la sogs pa'i rten rnams ji ltar bde bar bzhugs su gsol/ cog tse sogs stegs kyi khar/ ras la sogs pa'i gzhi gtsang ma'i steng du mañdzi la maṇ+ḍal khru gang las mi chung ba bzhag par/ dbus dang phyogs bzhir dri bzang gi thig le tshom grangs dang mthun par tshom bu dgu re dang / de'i phyi'i phyogs bzhir re re dgod/ yang maṇ+ḍal zhig la sa lha'i tshom bu bkod la mañdzi'i 'og tu bzhag de'i g.yas bdag gi g.yon nas zhabs bsil la sogs pa'i chu bzhi mdun nas rgyab tu bsgrigs/ de'i g.yon rang gi g.yas nas me tog la sogs pa'i nyer spyod lnga mdun nas rgyab tu bsgrigs/ mdun phyogs su bzed zhal gyi snod gsum du me tog cung zad dang bcas pa bshams/ de dag gi nang du spos mar me/ lha bshos te sgos mchod lha'i grangs dang mnyam par byed na rdo rje can gyi sgos mchod/ shar du lhag gcig dang phyogs mtshams brgyad du re re/ de'i phyi'i nub tu phan pa'i sgos mchod spos dgu/ de'i rgyab tu mar me dgu/ de'i rgyab tu zhal zas dgu gral bsgrigs/ byang du rdo rje nyi ma'i sgos mchod dang /

shar du pad+ma gar dbang gi sgos mchod/ lhor rta mchog gi sgos mchod rnams kyi sgrig rim gong bzhin/ de'i phyi'i phyogs bzhir sgo ma bzhi la re re/ shar du sa lha'i sgos mchod/ ma 'byor na dkyil 'khor gyi grangs dang mnyam pa ste shar du rdo rje can gyi gtso bo dang / 'khor thun mong la spos me zan tshar gnyis/ phyogs gzhan bzhi la re re/ nub tu sgo ma bzhi la gcig shar du sa yi lha mo la gcig rnams bshams/ de yang sgos mchod kyi chu gsum bzed zhal gyi nang du blugs pas 'grub/ 'thor 'thung dang dri chab kyang phyi mchod de nyid nas 'thor yab kyis 'thor bas 'grub/ me tog kyang phyi mchod de nyid nas 'thor bas 'grub pa la dgongs/ sa'i lha mo'i gtor ma dang / gzhan yang gos zung dang / bum pa sta gon gyi phyir mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa gnyis rdo rus la sogs pas dkar por byugs la lha'i kha dog dang mthun par dar ram ras kha tshar ma nyams pas mgul chings prog lnga pa'am bdun byas la/ las thams cad la bzlas pa'i srad bu dkar por bcings/ rnam rgyal la rigs lnga'i mtshan ma dang / las thams cad pa la sna tshogs rdo rje nyi ma la gnas pa bris nas las thams cad pa bzlas pas bum pa gnyis la yungs dkar gyis brab cing / gu gul gyis bdugs nas bgegs bsangs/ nas/ gro/ sran ma/ 'bras/ til te 'bru lnga/ gser/ dngul/ byu ru/ mu tig dung ste rin chen lnga/ lan tshwa/ bu ram/ 'o ma/ mar/ sbrang rtsi ste snying po lnga/ tsan+dan dkar dmar/ gur kum/ dza ti/ ga bur ste dri lnga/ bri hāsti/ kaṇ+ḍa ka ri/ a pa rā dzi ta dkar po/ ha sa ha sa de wa ste sman lnga dang / sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga/ ci 'byor pa blugs/ bdud rtsi ril bus 'thus/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las lha mo mdog sna tshogs pa spros te/ chu bo gaṅgā nas chu blangs te 'gengs par bsam la/ oṃ tap+te tap+te ma hā tap+te swāhā/ zhes lan bdun bdun bzlas la/ bum pa'i sum cha dri zhim po'i chus dgang /

oṃ hūm̐ swāhās shing rlon pas kha brgyan pa/ g.yas su rnam rgyal dang g.yon du las bum bzhag rnam rgyal bum pa'i steng du dung chos dri bzang gi chus bkang ba dang / gzungs thag btags pa'i rdo rje bzhag slob ma sta gon byed na mtshams sbyor nas byung ba'i yo byad rnams kyang bshams/ dkyil 'khor gyi byang nas shar lho'i bar la 'das pa'i gtor ma dang / gur mgon dang / zhal bzhi pa dang / las mgon dang mkha' 'gro spyi gtor rnams g.yas bskor dang / logs shig tu sngon 'gro'i gtor ma dang bcas pa rnams kyang bsham mo/ /dngos gzhi bdag bskyed bzlas brjod rjes/ /dkyil 'khor bsdus nas sa lha dang / /lha dang bum pa slob ma rnams/ /lhag par gnas pa rim bzhin bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ thog mar rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ sngon 'gro gtor ma chab kyis bran te/ slob dpon gyis rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bgegs bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes pas stong par bsam pas sbyangs/ 'og tu bsangs sbyangs zhes bya ba rnams su'ang 'di dran par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma la lag pa g.yon pa bstan te/ oṃ/ g.yas pa bstan te/ āḥ gnyis ka bstan te/ hūm̐/ bya khyung gi phyag rgya bstan te/ hoḥ zhes dang / bya khyung gi phyag rgya ni/ gdan bzhi las/ thal mo gnyis ni bkan byas te/ /ming med gnyis ni phan tshun sbrel/ /khro bo gnyis kyis mnan par bya/ /mthe bong gung mo lto sbyar la/ /zhes pa ltar ro/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum brjod/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar chos 'byung gsum brgyud kyi nang du chud pa'i pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la gnas pa'i 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya se gol dang bcas pas gtor mgron spyan drangs/

pad kor sngon 'gro'i rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ an+di/ dza ma/ dza la/ dzak+kha/ bhu ta/ bah+ni/ bā u/ rāk+kha/ tsan+da/ sūdz+dza/ ma da/ pap+pa/ ta la pā ta laṃ/ aṭa ṭha/ sap+pa swāhā/ i daṃ ba liṃ/ bhuñdza/ dzi gha/ phul+la/ dhūp+pa/ maṃ sa/ ping gha/ am+bha/ sap+pa/ kadz+dza/ sā dā/ khan+ti/ khu ṇi/ phe ḍa/ gā da/ oṃ ā kā ro mu khaṃ sarba dharmāḥṇāṃ ad+ya nut+pan+na twata oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul bas mgron rnams mnyes shing tshim nas ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol bar bsam/ de nas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes sogs kyis phyi mchod 'bul/ oṃ ma hā bhu ta sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod nas g.yon pa'i srin lag gis blang ste mthe bo'i rtses gtor te phul/ rdo rje nu ma g.yas steng bzung / /dril bu snying kha'i thad du dkrol/ /lag pa nu ma'i steng du bsgyings/ /sgra ni sku gsung thugs su sgrogs/ /zhes pa ltar dril bu gsum brdung byas la/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing / /puk+ka sī ni rdo rje'i lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol pa mo ni cang te'u brdung / /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /'dod chags chen po'i rjes chags pas/ /g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces yid las byung bas mchod/ mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /rdo rje dbyings ni mkha' chen po/ /rdo rje gsum mchog dkyil 'khor gsum/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par snang mdzad dag pa ste/ /rdo rje zhi ba dga' chen po/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal mchog /sangs rgyas mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rin chen rgyal po rab tu zab/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro dri ma med/

/rang bzhin dag pas gos pa med/ /rin chen mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdo rje dpag med rgyal po che/ /mi rtog rdo rje nam mkha' 'dzin/ /'dod chags pha rol phyin pa brnyes/ /pad+ma mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /don yod rdo rje rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa/ /dngos kun dag pa nyid las byung / /sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces bstod/ phrin las bcol ba ni/ lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /klu chen brgyad po 'khor bcas dang / /'jig rten skyong ba brgyad po dang / /gnod sbyin tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /srin po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /'byung po'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /yi dwags tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /sha za'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /smyo byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /brjed byed tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /ma mo'i tshogs rnams ma lus dang / /de la sogs te 'byung po'i tshogs/ /ma lus ji snyed yod pa rnams/ /'dir gshegs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bsnoms la/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /nad med tshe dang dbang phyug dang / /dpal dang grags dang skal ba bzang / /longs spyod rgya chen kun thob cing / /zhi dang rgyas la sogs pa yi/ /las kyi dngos grub bdag la stsol/ /dam tshig can gyis bdag la srungs/ /dngos grub kun gyi stong grogs mdzod/ /dus min 'chi dang nad rnams dang / /gdon dang bgegs rnams med par mdzod/ /rmi lam ngan dang mtshan ma ngan/ /bya byed ngan pa med par mdzod/ /'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /dge legs thams cad 'grub pa dang / /yid la 'dod pa kun grub shog /ces pa'i mthar/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub mkha' 'gro lnga'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang /

bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang bskur gyi skabs slob ma 'jug cing sogs brjod dbang blang bar 'tshal na/ srung ma khyad par can khyed rnams kyis dkyil 'khor chen po'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar du sgrub khang gi phyi rol gyi phyogs mtshams rnams su bzhugs nas bar du gcod pa thams cad srung ba dang / de nas kyang byang chub ma thob kyi bar du bsrung ba dang bskyab pa dang sba ba'i phrin las mdzod cig muḥ zhes pas lag pa g.yas pa brkyangs te sa la reg pas gtor mgron rnams sgrub khang gi phyi rol tu 'khod par bsam/ gang dag nag po'i phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i 'byung po gdug pa can gsang spyod blta bar mi dbang ba rnams sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par gzhan du song zhig ces dang / oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dha ra ya dha ra ya/ mar+dha mar+dha/ badz+ra dhṛka phaṭa swāhā/ ces brjod cing rdo rje gsor dril bu drag tu dkrol/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar bskyal lo/ /de nas gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmaḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las gnas khang bh+rūṃ las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i thar pa chen po'i gzhal yas khang gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhis mdzes shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang gi mchod rdzas rnams a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor thung / mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa rgyu 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las grub pa ngo bo bzang zhing gtsang ba/ yul nam mkha'i mtha' khyab pa/ dus 'khor ba ji srid ma stongs kyi bar du rgyun mi chad par gyur/

oṃ nī ri hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nī wi te hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra shwa dha ne swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ mthar rdo rje snying khar bzung dril bu rgyun dkrol dang rol mo ji snyed pa 'bud dkrol bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta/ pra ra ṇi ta/ saṃ pra ra ṇi ta/ sarba bud+dha k+ṣe tra/ pra tsa li te/ pra dzñā pā ra mi ta/ nā da swa bhā we badz+ra dharma hṛ da ya/ san+to ṣa ṇi/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥhoḥhoḥ.ā khaṃ swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod de gnas dang mchod pa'i yo byad rnams sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad kyis kyang byin gyis brlabs par bsam/ gong gi mchod pa rnams kyi phyag rgya ni/ khu tshur kha sbyar gung mo gnyis/ /brkyang ste rtse sbyar chu bzhi'i rgya/ /khu tshur gyen 'thor me tog gi /thur du blugs pas bdug pa'i 'o/ /mthe bong gyen bsgreng mar me ste/ /thal mo phyir bstan dri mchog gi /de nyid gyen bkan zhal zas so/ /se gol gtog pa rol mo'i sgra/ /zhes pa ltar 'og gi mchod pa rnams la'ang phyag rgya de bzhin shes par bya'o/ /lugs 'di la bar 'dir sa lha sta gon byas nas bdag bskyed sogs yin kyang 'dir ni gong gi sdom ltar 'go nas bzhag yod do/ /de nas skyabs yul rnams mngon sum lta bur dmigs te/ ngag tu/ bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad kyi ngo bo/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag rje btsun rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/

/rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o/ /zhes ci nus kyi mthar thal mo sbyar te/ bla ma dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /khyed rnams kyis bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ skyabs yul rnams 'od du zhu nas rang la thim par bsam/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo nyams su blang bar bgyi'o/ /lan gsum gyis sems bskyed/ rang gi spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dpal he ru ka sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rang 'dra'i rigs bdag gis dbu rgyan can/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ yab kyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ dkar po de las 'od 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs kyi snying po ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs nas hūm̐ la thim/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad kyis 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ hūm̐ las bdud rtsi babs/ he ru ka'i sku gang / de nas dbyibs brgyud/ yum gyi sku gang / yab yum gyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi spyi gtsug nas zhugs pas nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad dud khu'am rnag khrag gi rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas 'thon pas shul thams cad bdud rtsis gang bar gyur/

oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sa ma ya ma nu pā la ya/ he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha dri ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān badz+ra he ru ka ma me muñtsa/ he ru ko bha wa/ mahā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste/ /dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams/ /bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ /thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can/ /'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so/ /sdig pa dang sgrib pa nyes pa dang ltung ba dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum 'od du zhu ste spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus 'ja' tshon lta bur gyur/ ces brjod/ tshogs zhing spyan drang ba ni/ rang skad cig gis rdo rje mkha' 'gror gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐/ oṃ/ trām̐/ ām̐/ kham̐ gi yi ge rnams dri ma med pa'i 'od zer lnga 'phro ba de las 'od zer sna bug g.yas pa nas rlung phyir rgyu ba'i dus su nam mkhar 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas mkha' 'gro lnga'i dkyil 'khor la bla ma mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i dbu brgyan pa la phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag bya/ phyag 'tshal ba ni rdo rje thal mo snying khar sbyar te/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ zhes pas bla ma dang / na maḥpañtsa ḍā ka maṇ+ḍa la sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ zhes pas dkyil 'khor la phyag bya/ mchod 'bul ni rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las lha mo brgyad rang rang gi mchod rdzas 'dzin pa spros te/

phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pas mchod par bsam zhing / ngag tu/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /nas/ g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /bar gong bzhin brjod/ rgyun bshags bya ba ni/ don yid la dran bzhin pas/ ngag tu/ bdag gis thog ma med dus nas/ /log rtog dbang gis sdig bgyis gang / /thugs rje'i mnga' bdag khyed rnams kyi/ /spyan sngar bshags kyis slan chad bsdam/ /rgyal dang de yi sras rnams dang / /rang sangs rgyas dang dgra bcom dang / /'gro ba'i bsod nams ma lus pa/ /de dag kun la yi rang ngo / /kun 'dod dbugs 'byin gsol mdzad pa'i/ /sangs rgyas kun la bdag bskul bas/ /bstan pa nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam par/ /'jig rten kun sdig med snang mdzod/ /'gro kun sangs rgyas gyur gyi bar/ /de srid mgon po bzhugs nas ni/ /nam yang mya ngan mi 'da' bar/ /thal mo sbyar nas gsol bar 'tshal/ /lus ngag yid kyi bsod nams ni/ /bgyis sam bgyid du stsal ba dang / /rjes su yi rang gang ci'ang rung / /des ni 'jig rten kun mkhyen shog /gang dang gang gis 'dul gyur ba/ /de dang de yi skur ston cing / /sna tshogs gzugs nor lta bu yi/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi/ /kun rtog ma lus dag gyur pa/ /rang rig yang dag ye shes bskyed/ /lhan cig skyes dga'i ngo bo nyid/ /dam pa'i chos la skyabs su mchi/ /go rim ji bzhin dbang bskur thob/ /ma log lam la nges gnas pa'i/ /sras mchog 'khor 'dus dge 'dun la/ /rtag par bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /yang dag ye shes me bo che/ /gti mug mun pa bsal ba dang / /byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do/ /rgyal sras dpa' bo rnams kyi lam/ /spyod pa dpag yas gang yin dang / /ma bcos ji bzhin lam gnas la/ /da ni yang dag gnas par bgyi/ /lan gsum brjod/ ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na med/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/

/tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang / /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum/ /so sor brtan por bzung bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por bzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /slob dpon dag kyang bzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la/ /nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba'i/ /pad+ma'i rigs chen dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus bzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du bzung bar bgyi/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag gis sdom pa ma lus bzung / /ma bsgral ba rnams bdag gis bsgral/ /ma grol ba rnams bdag gis dgrol/ /dbugs ma phyung ba dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god/ /ces lan gsum/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang dus rtag tu mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang thams cad dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig ces brjod/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad sems tsam dang / sems de yang snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma dang / sgyu ma de yang mi dmigs par bsam la/ oṃ shū n+ya ta dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /bsnyen pa'i yan lag stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis nam mkha'i dbyings su sems kyi snang ba las byung ba'i/

paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ mthing nag las byung ba'i sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo rwa nyi shu pa rnams shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / lte ba mthing nag la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ hūm̐ de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas 'og rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ 'khor yug rdo rje nag po gdengs pa 'bring por gyur pa bar mtshams med pa'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ rwa ba'i phyi rol tu bskal pa 'jig pa'i dus kyi me dang mtshungs pa'i ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga 'bar bas mtshan bskor bar gyur/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces lan gsum brjod la byin gyis brlabs/ de lta bu'i thun mong ba'i bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ ser po yongs su gyur pa las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa/ rtse mo rno ba/ khog pa stong pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba/ brtan cing go skabs med pa/ g.yon phyogs su myur du 'khor bar gyur/ oṃ badz+ra tsakra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs bcur pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re/ de rnams kyi steng du hūm̐ re re/ de yang dbus kyi ser po/ lho'i dkar po/ nub kyi dmar po/ gzhan thams cad sngon po de rnams yongs su gyur pa las dbus su rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba ser po 'khor lo 'dzin pa/ shar du gshin rje gshed sngon po tho ba 'dzin pa/ lhor shes rab mthar byed dkar po be con 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma mthar byed dmar po pad+ma 'dzin pa/ byang du bgegs mthar byed nag po rdo rje 'dzin pa/ dbang ldan du 'dod pa'i rgyal po nag po lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ mer dbyug sngon can sngon po dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ bden bral du mi g.yo ba sngon po ral gri 'dzin pa/

rlung du stobs po che nag po rtse gsum 'dzin pa/ steng du hūm̐ mdzad nag po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu rang gi phyag rgyas thugs kar bsnol nas 'dzin pa/ 'og tu gnod mdzes nag po gtun shing 'dzin pa/ hūm̐ mdzad ma gtogs pa gzhan thams cad phyag g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'phyar ba'i tshul du 'dzin cing / g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa/ dbus dang phyogs bzhi'i khro bo rnams brjid pa'i khro bo ste/ zhal mche ba gtsigs shing dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan pa sku sbom zhing thung la gsus khyim che ba/ dbu skra dang smin ma dang sma ra dmar ser gyen du 'bar pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ klu chen po brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ gzhan rnams ni mdzes pa'i khro bo ste cung zad sgeg cing yid tsam khros pa/ sku skem zhing grims pa dbu skra nag po'i thor cog can/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ thams cad kyang zhabs g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par gyur/ de ltar dam tshig pa bskyed nas sgrub pa'i yan lag ni/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas srung ba'i 'khor lo ye shes kyi khro bo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ e h+ye hi badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pa ri wa ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra ma hā kro dha rā dza sa pā ri wā ra/ oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khāṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nī wi ti hūm̐ khāṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba paṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī a kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra we sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bai tā li ban+dha bāṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ

zhes dgug gzhug bcing dbang du bya'o/ /de dag gi phyag rgya ni/ khu tshur g.yon gyi mthe'u chung dang / /g.yas pa'i mdzub sbrel lcags kyu ste/ /khu tshur rgyab sbyar zhags mig ltar/ /byas pa zhags pa'i phyag rgya'o/ /mthe'u chung mdzub mo phan tshun du/ /so sor sbrel ba lcags sgrog yin/ /khu tshur bcangs pa'i mkhrig ma gnyis/ /bsnol ba'i phyag rgya dril bu'o/ /zhes pa ste/ 'og tu/ gau rī la sogs pa'i phyag rgya zhes 'byung ba rnams su'ang 'di rnams dran par bya'o/ /de nas nyer sgrub ni/ lha de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma/ /rna bar zhe sdang rdo rje ma/ /sna la ser sna rdo rje ma/ /kha la 'dod chags rdo rje ma/ /lus la phrag dog rdo rje ma/ /yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /spyi bor sku rdo rje ma/ /mgrin par gsung rdo rje ma/ /thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ /zhes sku gsung thugs kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'o/ /sgrub pa chen po ni/ slar yang rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nī wi ti hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ni swāhā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ gi bar gyis mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /bcom ldan bdag nyid chen po rnams/ /thugs rje'i rang bzhin can rnams kyis/ /khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur stsol/ /zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi/ /khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa/ /rdo rje'i dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ /oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba/

gshin rje gshed/ dbyug sngon can rnams la rnam par snang mdzad/ shes rab mthar byed/ 'dod rgyal/ gnod mdzes rnams la mi bskyod pa/ pad+ma mthar byed dang stobs po che la 'od dpag med/ bgegs mthar byed dang mi g.yo ba rnams la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan par bsam ste/ khro bo'i dbang po rnams kyi gzi brjid kyis bar du gcod pa'i bgegs thams cad bskrad de/ dpag tshad brgya'i tshad tshun chad bsrung bar bsam ste/ hūm̐/ ring po brjod pa 'di sta gon kho na la gsung srol yod/ dbang bskur zhing rigs kyi bdag pos rgyas gdab pa'o/ /rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad rdo rje phra mo dpag tu med pas gtams par bsam/ hūm̐ de nyid rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa gyen du langs pa gcig tu gyur te/ de'i lte ba stong par yod pa'i nang du rang gi sems hūm̐ gcig tu bsam/ de'i steng la sogs pa gang bsrung bar 'dod pa de'i ming gi yi ge dang po bsam ste/ de yang bla ma bsrung bar 'dod na steng du/ rang nyid nang du/ spun zla g.yon du/ pha ma mdun du/ bu dang chung ma g.yas su/ 'khor rgyab tu/ nor rdzas rnams 'og tu bsam/ gang mi bsrung ba'i sa stong par bzhag go /de nas 'khor lo'i phyogs mtshams brgyad kyi rtsibs med pa'i bar du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ gnod byed lus rid pa/ skra 'dzings pa/ kha nas khrag skyug pa spyi'u tshugs su 'dug par bsam/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas/ gnod byed kyi shes pa bkug ste de la thim par bsam la/ rang gtsug tor 'khor los bsgyur bas hūm̐ zhes brjod pa phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo rnams zhal phyir gzigs/ dbus dang steng 'og gi khro bo rnams zhabs g.yas brkyang / 'khor lo g.yon du myur du 'khor bas gnod byed kyi lus rlung gis bskyod/ mes bsreg cing 'khor lo'i rtse mor gtubs pas kho'i thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib sbyangs nas rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par bsam zhing sngags bzla/

na maḥs man+ta bud+dhā nāṃ/ na maḥs mān+ta dharma nāṃ/ na maḥs man+ta saṃ ghā nāṃ/ oṃ si tā ta pa tre/ oṃ bi ma la/ oṃ shang ka ra/ oṃ pra t+yaṃ gi ra/ badz+ra uṣ+ṇi ṣa tsakra warti/ sarba yan+t+ra man+t+ra mū la karma/ ban+dha nāṃ/ tā ḍa nāṃ/ kī la nāṃ wā/ ma ma kṛ te/ ye na ke na tsi ta/ kṛ tan+tata/ sarbān+tu/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ bhin+da bhin+da/ tsi ri tsi ri/ gi ri gi ri/ mā ra mā ra/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas/ spro na/ oṃ bha ya nā sa ni/ trā sa ni/ sarba mā ra pra t+yaṃ gi ra/ bi nā sa ni/ ye ge tsi ta/ duṣ+ṭan satwa/ ma ma bi ru pa kaṃ kurban ti tā ni/ sarba mā ra ṇi prat+yaṃ kā ri ni pa ta tu hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes pa'ang ci rigs bzlas la rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ su gang dag bdag cag gi dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang / bdag cag la sdang ba'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / gdug pa'i sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / drag shul gyi sems dang ldan pa rnams dang / bsam pa dang sbyor ba ngan par byed pa'i dgra bgegs thams cad kyi bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad zhi bar gyur cig gal te zhi bar ma gyur na de'i tshe de dag thams cad kyi lus bcing bar bgyi'o/ /ngag bcing bar bgyi'o/ /yid bcing bar bgyi'o/ / zhes brjod cing lag mthil gnyis su hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje dang sor mo rnams rdo rje rtse gcig par bsam ste/ gnod byed rnams de'i bar du btsir bar bsam la thal mo brdab/ rang gi thugs ka nas rang 'dra ba'i khro bo mtshon cha thogs pa du ma spros te gnod byed kyi lus dang dbang po thams cad rdul phra rab tu byas/ mes bsreg rlung gis gtor bar bsam la/ mthu rlag par gyur cig rdzu 'phrul brlag par gyur cig stobs brlag par gyur cig des bzlas pa'i sngags kyis de nyid brlag par gyur cig des bsgrub pa'i lha 'dres de nyid kyi sha za bar gyur cig khro bo 'bar ba'i tshogs rnams kyis/

/dgra bgegs rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /lus ngag thal ba rdul du rlog /rnam shes chos kyi dbyings su sgrol/ /zhes brjod/ oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes brjod pa ni bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'o/ /'di ni ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyi bsrung 'khor gyi tshe gnod pa phyir bzlog pa'i 'khor lo bsgom la uṣ+ṇī ṣa bzla zhes gsungs pa bzhin rgyun gyi ngag 'don ltar bris pa yin no/ /gnyis pa dngos gzhi lha'i rnal 'byor la gnyis te/ bskyed pa'i rim pa dang rdzogs pa'i rim pa'o/ /dang po gzhal yas khang bskyed pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi yan lag ni/ rang nyid gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur ba zhu ba las chos kyi 'byung gnas phyogs kun nas gru gsum pa gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba rtsa ba phra ba thur du zug pa yangs shing rgya che ba de'i nang du yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs can mchog ma gnyis kyi ngos su g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar po gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa chus gang bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor ser po gru bzhi zur bzhir rdo rje rtse gsum pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo ser po rtsibs bcu pa bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de rnams kyi steng du oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdamar po gnyis kyis steng 'og nas mtha' brten pa'i rang gi bar do'i rnam par shes pa 'dres pa las rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang pa gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa/ phyi nas rim pa bzhin dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang khu/ nag po'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rtsig pa'i steng na rin po che'i pha gu ser po la drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ de'i steng na bya 'dab las thur du 'phyang ba'i mda' yab dang /

steng du rin po che'i drwa mig seng ma'i pu shus mdzes par byas pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan cing steng rdo rje'i gdung zlum po dang / de'i steng du rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bres nas mdzes par phub pa'i dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i steng du rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis spras pa ches mtho zhing yangs pa'i sgo bzhi'i steng gi thad sor ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor dbus su chos kyi 'khor lo dang / steng du gdugs/ g.yas dang g.yon du ri dwags/ gzhan yang gos dang 'phan dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang / rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can la sogs pa rgyan du mas brgyan pa/ rtsig pa'i rtsa ba'i phyi rol na 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i lha mo bcu drug phyogs re nas bzhi bzhi 'dzum pa'i bzhin la mdzes pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing lag na mchod rdzas du ma thogs pas mchod pa byed pa sgo dang sgo 'khyud dang grwa rnams su zla ba phyed pa la gnas pa'i rdo rje rin po ches spras pa/ rgya dang tshad yongs su ma chad pa ye shes kyi snang ba las grub cing rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang par gyur/ gzhal yas khang pa'i phyi rol rdo rje'i rwa ba'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad gnas pa ni shar du gtum drag gi dur khrod/ lhor 'jigs byed thod pa can/ nub tu 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ byang shar du drag tu dgod pa/ shar lhor dbang phyug nags tshal/ lho nub tu 'jigs byed mun pa/ nub byang du ki li ki la'i sgra sgrog pa'i dur khrod do/ /de dag na yod pa'i shing chen po brgyad ni/ shar du shi ri sha'i shing / lhor tsu ta/ nub tu kaṅka la/ byang du a shwat+ṭha/ byang shar du shing chen po/ shar lhor ka rañtsa/ lho nub tu 'khril shing can/ nub byang du urdzu na'o/

/shing de dag gi rtsa ba na gnas pa'i phyogs skyong ba chen po brgyad ni/ shar du brgya byin ser po glang po che la zhon pa shin tu brjid pa phyag g.yon na rdo rjes mtshan pa'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he la zhon pa mi'u thung lta bu lto ba 'phyang zhing skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa g.yon thod pa dang dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu chu lha dkar po chu srin la zhon pa sbrul gyis brgyan cing g.yon thod pa dang zhags pa thogs pa/ byang du gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po rta la zhon pa mi'u thung lta bu gsus pa 'phyang ba/ g.yon thod pa dang rin po ches mtshan pa'i dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ byang shar du dbang ldan dkar po glang la zhon pa mig gsum pa can g.yon thod pa dang mdung 'dzin pa/ shar lhor me lha dmar ser ra skyes la zhon pa phyag bzhi'i g.yas dbyu gu dang thod pa/ g.yon spyi blugs dang 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu srin po sngon po ro langs la zhon pa mi'u thung gi gzugs can gsus pa 'phyang ba skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yon thod pa dang ral gri 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rlung lha sngon po ri dwags la zhon pa zhi ba'i gdong pa can g.yon thod pa dang ba dan 'dzin pa/ rang rang gi rgyan gyis brgyan cing thams cad kyi phyag g.yas pas bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal ba'i tshul byed pa'o/ /shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong ba chen po brgyad ni/ shar du lha'i dge 'dun dkar po glang po che'i gdong pa can/ lhor gshin rje sngon po ma he'i gdong pa can/ nub tu sprin gyi rgyal po dmar po chu srin gyi gdong pa can/ byang du gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon ser po rta'i gdong pa can/ byang shar du yi dwags 'dus pa dud kha glang gi gdong pa can/ shar lhor drang srong 'dus pa dmar po ra skyes kyi gdong pa can/ lho nub tu srin po'i tshogs can sngon po ro langs kyi gdong pa can/

nub byang du rlung lha sngon po ri dwags kyi gdong pa can/ thams cad kyang shing lo'i gseb nas lus phyed tsam 'thon pa/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa bzhin 'gyur ba skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes pa'o/ /sprin chen po brgyad ni/ shar du sgrog byed ser po/ lhor ldog byed sngon po/ nub tu 'jigs byed dkar po/ byang du 'khor byed ser po/ byang shar du thug po dkar po/ shar lhor 'geng byed dmar ser/ lho nub tu char 'bebs sngon po/ nub byang du gtum po sngon po/ sprin de dag la gnas pa'i klu chen po brgyad ni/ shar du nor rgyas ser po/ lhor pad+ma dkar po/ nub tu karko ṭa nag po/ byang du 'jog po dmar po/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po dkar po/ shar lhor hu lun+ta sngon po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan ljang khu/ nub byang du dung skyong ser po ste thams cad kyang sbrul mgo'i gdengs ka bdun dang ldan cing stod lha'i gzugs can thal mo sbyar ba smad sbrul mjug 'khyil ba'o/ /gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten brgyad/ thugs rje'i chu brgyad/ ye shes kyi me brgyad/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma dang / ro mgo bo bcad pa dang / dpyangs pa dang / bsnyal ba dang / gsal shing gis phug pa dang / mgo bo dang / keng rus dang / ce spyang dang / khwa dang / 'ug pa dang / bya rgod dang / ro langs rnams phaiṃ zhes bya ba'i sgra sgrog par byed pa dang / gnod sbyin dang / srin po dang / 'byung po dang / yi dwags dang / sha za dang / smyo byed dang / brjed byed dang / gdon dang / mkha' 'gro dang / mkha' 'gro ma dang / sgrub pa po rnams dang bcas pas yongs su gang ba'i dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba'i gzhal yas khang gi nang gi phyogs mdog shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang / dbus sngo ba/ de'i dbus su rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor la dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/

shar du phan pa'i dkyil 'khor la dkar sngo dmar ljang ser po'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ lhor rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la dkar sngo dmar ljang ser ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ nub tu pad+ma gar dbang gi dkyil 'khor la dkar ser sngo ljang dmar ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ byang du rta'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor la dkar ser dmar sngo ljang ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ thams cad kyi phyi'i dbyibs ni gru bzhi sgo bzhi 'dod yon gyi snam bu dang / pha gu dang / drwa ba dang drwa ba phyed pa dang / mda' yab dang / pu shu la sogs pas brgyan cing nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan zhing / steng rdo rje'i gdung bzhis mig mang ris su bres pa dbus phyur bur gyur pa'i rtse mor rdo rje rin po che'i tog gis mdzes par byas pa/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i nang gi dbyibs ni rdo rje can gyi zla ba phyed pa/ phan pa'i zlum po/ nyi ma'i rin po che zur brgyad pa/ gar dbang gi pad+ma/ rta mchog gi chos 'byung gi dbyibs lta bu rtsig pa'i rim pa dang mthun pa'i lha snam phyogs mdog can no/ /de lta bu'i gzhal yas khang rnams kyi dbus su pad+ma dkar dmar 'dab ma brgyad pa re re'i lte bar tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po ste bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi snying khar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ shar du zla ba phyogs gzhan rnams la yang nyi ma'i gdan/ 'dab ma brgyad po rnams dang / phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhir zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / ro'i gdan/ bsgom pa la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta nī la ya badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod de byin gyis brlab bo/ /gnyis pa rjes su chags pa rdo rje sems dpa'i yan lag la gsum ste/ dam tshig sems dpa' bskyed pa/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya ba/ sku mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa'o/

/dang po la bzhi ste/ sku rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa/ 'khor gyi lha mo dbyung ba/ zhu ba las glus bskul ba/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs pa'o/ /dang po ni/ gtso bo lnga'i gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan sum cu so gnyis kyi ngo bo/ a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ lī/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ aḥ phrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa ā lis mtshan pa lngar gyur pa ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du dpe byad bzang po sum cu'i ngo bo ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ phrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum pa kā lis mtshan pa lngar gyur pa mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ de rnams kyi mi thub zla bas/ hūm̐ byung rdo rje bsgom par bya/ /'od zer dkar po'i phreng ba'o/ /de ltar so sor nges pa ni/ /sa bon lnga las phyag mtshan lnga/ /zhes gsungs pa la brten nas/ bla ma dag dbang thog mar rdo rje rtse lnga de yongs su gyur pa las so so'i phyag mtshan lnga bsgom par bzhed mod/ gzhung gi dgongs pas snga ma rdo rje can gyi dbang du byas shing phyi ma de bzhin rigs lnga char yin par mngon no// steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer dkar po'i 'phreng ba 'phro ba/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas sems can thams cad mkha' 'gro lnga'i go 'phang la thob/ tshur 'dus rdo rje la thim/ de rnams zhu ba las hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ ām̐ khām̐ rnams su gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ ral gri rnams su gyur pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ zla ba nyis brtsegs phyag mtshan dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes/ de dag las mkha' 'gro lnga'i rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su gyur pa ni/

dbus su rdo rje can gyi rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ shar du phan pa'i rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ lhor rdo rje nyi ma'i rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ nub tu pad+ma gar dbang gi rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa/ byang du rta'i rgyal po'i rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa ste/ thams cad kyang zla ba ltar dkar zhing chu shel ltar dwangs pa/ nor bu ltar 'od 'phro ba/ zhal brgyad pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rdo rje can gyi rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/ g.yas gnag g.yon dmar ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na glang po che/ rta/ bong bu/ glang / rnga mong / mi/ sha ra pa/ byi la/ g.yon pa rnams na sa'i lha/ chu'i lha/ me'i lha/ rlung gi lha/ zla ba'i lha/ nyi ma'i lha/ gshin rje gnod sbyin rnams 'dzin pa/ rtsa zhal gyi spyi bor rdo rje nag pos mtshan cing yum mā ma ki sku mdog nag mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ phan pa'i rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/ g.yas gnag g.yon dmar ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na rma bya/ ma he/ chu srin/ ma ka ra/ rus sbal/ 'og gi klu/ ngang skya/ ri bong / g.yon pa rnams na sbal pa thu'u/ sprin shugs/ sbrul ha la/ rtsang pa nag po/ byi ba/ g.yag gla ba/ bya bzhad rnams 'dzin pa/ rtsa zhal gyi spyi bor 'khor lo dkar pos mtshan cing yum sangs rgyas spyan ma sku mdog dkar po dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rdo rje nyi ma'i rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/ g.yas ser/ g.yon dmar/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na bya ka ran+da/ ngur pa/ lug bye'u tsa ko ra/ bya khra/ hor khra/ 'ol pa/ nya khra/ g.yon pa rnams na stobs kyi rgyu/ dung skyong / rigs ldan/ pad+ma/ pad+ma chen po/ 'jog po/ nor rgyas/ mtha' yas rnams 'dzin pa/ rtsa zhal gyi spyi bor rin po che zur brgyad pas mtshan cing / yum rin chen sgrol ma sku mdog ser mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ pad+ma gar dbang gi rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/

g.yas gnag g.yon dmar ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na dom/ bya rgod/ bse/ ba men/ stag spre'u/ chu srin na kra/ ce spyang / g.yon pa rnams na khwa/ 'ug bya dkar/ ne tso/ seng ge sa pa ra/ kṛṣ+ṇa sa ri/ phag rnams 'dzin pa/ rtsa zhal gyi spyi bor pad+ma dmar pos mtshan cing yum gos dkar mo sku mdog dmar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ rta'i rgyal po'i rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rtsa ba'i zhal rta'i gdong pa can dkar po g.yas gnag g.yon ljang ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na gza' lhag phur bu/ mjug rings/ sgra gcan/ mig dmar/ pa sangs/ spen pa/ khyab mjug g.yon pa rnams na dbang po/ tshangs pa/ drag po/ bdud sdig can/ khyab mjug gi bu mo gshol mda' 'dzin/ lha rgyal ba dam pa/ thag bzang ris/ lha ma yin stobs ldan rnams 'dzin pa/ rtsa zhal gyi spyi bor ral gri dkar pos mtshan cing / yum dam tshig sgrol ma sku mdog ljang khu dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ thams cad kyi steng zhal dud kha/ rgyab zhal bzhi nag pa/ zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhis mdzes pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ mi mgo skam po rdzogs pa lnga lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ spyi bor rus pa'i 'khor lo/ rna ba la rna cha/ mgul pa la mgul brgyan/ lag pa dang rkang pa la gdu bu/ sked pa la ske rags/ se ral khar mchod phyir thogs/ lus thams cad la thal chen gyi rgya ste phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyang ba'i brla la/ g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis bzhugs pa/ sgeg pa dpa' ba mi sdug pa/ /rgod pa drag shul 'jigs su rung / /rnying rje rngam dang zhi ba ste/ /gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ /'di dag gi pang na gnas pa'i yum rnams kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing zhal mche ba gtsigs pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ phyag g.yas pas gri gug sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing /

g.yon pa bdud bzhi'i khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab kyi mgul nas 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbu brgyan cing / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ thal chen ma gtogs pa'i phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gcer bu zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pas yab la 'khril ba/ yab yum thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /gnyis pa 'khor gyi lha mo dbyung ba la gnyis las/ dang po mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ yum rnams kyi mkha' mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las aḥlas pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa ze'u 'bru la aḥs mtshan pa/ yab kyi gsang gnas mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsam la/ oṃ pad+ma su ṣa dha ra ma hā rā ga su ṣan+dā tsa tu rā nan+da bha ga bi shwa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kar+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ oṃ badz+ra ma hā de ṣa tsa tu rā nan+da dā ya ka kha ga mu kha e ka ra so nā tha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kar+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ zhes brjod cing byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pa 'khor gyi lha mo dbyung ba dngos ni/ de nas/ yab yum thabs shes snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgyu ma bde ba'i sgras phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs/ rigs lnga so so'i zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar thig le brgyad brgyad dang / rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i yum gyi mkhar slar yang thig le bzhi rnams su gyur/ de rnams gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐/ pam̐ sām̐ bam̐ am̐ sam̐ dham̐ dām̐ gam̐ pām̐ dām̐ ram̐ tam̐ lam̐ ham̐ gam̐ nam̐/ pam̐ dham̐ s+pham̐ sham̐ wam̐ bām̐ mam̐ mam̐/ tam̐ kam̐ kam̐ sam̐ lam̐ mām̐ pam̐ tām̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes pa'i sa bon rnams su gyur/ de rnams so so'i yum gyi mkhar lha mo brgyad brgyad dang / rdo rje can gyi yum gyi mkhar slar yang lha mo bzhi rnams su gyur/ de rnams yum gyi mkha' nas phyir 'phros te so so'i phyogs mtshams kyi gdan rnams dang phyi'i sgo bzhir 'khod pa ni/

rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi 'dab ma la gau rī dkar mo g.yas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lhor tsau ri+ā ser mo g.yas rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu bai tā lī dmar mo g.yas lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang du ghasma rī ljang khu g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ byang shar du puk+ka sī nag mo g.yas ri rab 'dzin pa/ shar lhor sha ba rī dkar mo g.yas byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo sngon mo g.yas me thab 'dzin pa/ nub byang du g.yung mo ljang khu g.yas rlung gis bskyod pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ phan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi 'dab ma la skam ma nag mo g.yas skam pa 'dzin pa/ lhor zhags pa ma ser mo g.yas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub tu dol zlum ma dmar mo g.yas nya rgya 'dzin pa/ byang du lcags kyu ma ljang khu g.yas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ byang shar du me tog ma dkar mo g.yas me tog 'dzin pa/ shar lhor bdug pa ma dud kha g.yas spos snod 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu mar me ma ser mo g.yas mar me 'dzin pa/ nub byang du byug pa ma dmar mo g.yas dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa/ rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi 'dab ma la nyi lag ma dkar mo g.yas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ lhor mar me ma sngo dmar g.yas mar me'i mchod sdong 'dzin pa/ nub tu rin chen skar mda' ma ser mo g.yas rin po che 'dzin pa/ byang du glog lag ma ljang khu g.yas glog gi 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ byang shar du sgeg mo dkar mo g.yas khu tshur sked par 'jog pa/ shar lhor bzhad pa mo g.yas so'i 'phreng ba kha 'gram g.yas su 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu glu ma ser mo g.yas kha nas tshig 'byin pa'i tshul byed pa/ nub byang du gar ma ljang khu g.yas gar gyi tshul byed pa/ pad+ma gar dbang gi dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi 'dab ma la pad+ma can dkar mo g.yas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ lhor chos 'byung ma ser mo g.yas chos 'byung 'dzin pa/

nub tu lcags sgrog ma nag mo g.yas lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang du 'khyud ma ljang khu g.yas 'khyud pa'i tshul byed pa/ byang shar du gling bu ma ser mo g.yas gling bu 'dzin pa/ shar lhor pi wang ma dkar mo g.yas pi wang 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu rnga zlum ma ljang khu g.yas rnga zlum 'dzin pa/ nub byang du rdza rnga ma dkar mo g.yas rdza rnga 'dzin pa/ rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi 'dab ma la shar du sgo lcags ma dkar mo g.yas sgo lcags 'dzin pa/ lhor lde kyog ma ser mo g.yas lde kyog 'dzin pa/ nub tu sgo glegs ma dmar mo g.yas sgo glegs 'dzin pa/ byang du gos 'dzin ma sngon mo g.yas gos 'dzin pa/ byang shar du spyan ma dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo'i lte bar spyan gyis mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ shar lhor mā ma ki sngon mo g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ lho nub tu gos dkar mo dmar mo g.yas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ nub byang du sgrol ma ljang khu g.yas ut+pal 'dzin pa/ phyi'i shar sgor lcags kyu ma dkar mo g.yas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ lho sgor zhags pa ma ser mo g.yas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ nub sgor lcags sgrog ma dmar mo g.yas lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ byang sgor dril bu ma ljang gu g.yas dril bu 'dzin pa/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum dang ldan pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ g.yas pas rang rang gi phyag mtshan 'dzin cing g.yon pa thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ /mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu la brgyan cing skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ gcer bu phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /gsum pa la gnyis te/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa 'od du zhu ba/ zhu ba glus bskul ba'o/ /dang po ni/ de nas/ gtso bo yab yum lnga po snyoms par zhugs pas nam mkha' las oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥdamar po gnyis dang bcas pa'i rang gi bar do'i shes pa rigs lnga so so'i zhal du zhugs/

yum gyi mkhar sleb pa'i rkyen gyis yab yum rnams rjes chags kyi mes zhu nas byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin bde ba chen po rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bo thig le lngar gyur/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ gnyis pa ni/ de nas/ rang gi shes pa mtshams kyi lha mo bzhi'i nga rgyal du 'phos te thog mar puk+ka sis mi bskyod pa la bskul ba ni/ khyod ni zhe sdang rdo rje yongs skyong ba/ /thugs dam chos ni shin tu yang dag pa/ /lha yi lus ni yang dag rgyas mdzad pa/ /puk+ka sī ni bdag la myur du gzigs/ /rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten sman slad du/ /stong pa nyid spongs skye ba bzhes par mdzod/ /de bzhin du ri khrod mas rnam snang la/ khyod ni gti mug rdo rje yongs skyong ba/ /sku yi dag pa chos kyi gzugs brnyan gyis/ /lha yi lus ni༞ /ri khrod ma ni bdag la myur du gzigs/ /rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten sman slad du/ /stong pa nyid༞ /tsaṇ+ḍa līs 'od dpag med la/ khyod ni 'dod chags rdo rjes yongs skyong ba/ /rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten don gyi phyir/ /stong pa nyid༞ /g.yung mos rdo rje ma dang don yod grub pa gnyis la/ khyod ni sangs rgyas thams cad yongs skyong ba/ /gzugs kun nan tan thams cad mnyam nyid kyi/ /lha yi lus ni༞ /ḍom+bhi nī ni bdag la myur du gzigs/ /rnam par 'dren pa 'jig rten don gyi phyir/ /stong pa nyid spongs skye ba bzhes par mdzod/ /ces bskul lo/ /bzhi pa ni/ bsnyen pa'i yan lag de ltar bskul ba'i rkyen dang / sngon gyi smon lam gyi 'phen pas thig le de rnams cha gnyis gnyis su gyur pa las/ dbus kyi thig le hūm̐ māṃ/ shar gyi thig le oṃ lāṃ/ lho'i thig le traṃ taṃ/ nub kyi thig le āṃ paṃ/ byang gi thig le khāṃ taṃ gi sa bon rnams 'od 'bar zhing 'jigs par gyur/ de rnams yongs su gyur pa las mkha' 'gro lnga'i skur bzhengs pa ni/

dbus su thugs kyi mkha' 'gro sku mdog dbang po sngon po lta bu zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngo g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na glang po che/ rta/ bong bu/ sogs nas/ sbyor ba bar/ shar du rtag pa sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar zhing zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na rma bya/ ma he/ chu srin/ sogs nas/ sbyor ba bar/ lhor rin chen rgyal po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa rtsa ba'i zhal ser/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na bya ka ran+da/ ngur pa/ lug sogs nas/ sbyor ba bar/ nub tu rta mgrin sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba zhal brgyad phyag drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na dom/ bya rgod/ bse sogs nas/ sbyor ba bar/ byang du rta mchog in+d+ra nī la ltar ljang ba zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa rtsa zhal rta'i gdong pa can ljang khu/ g.yas gnag g.yon dkar ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na gza' lhag phur bu/ mjug ring sogs nas/ sbyor ba bar/ thams cad kyi steng zhal dud ka rgyab zhal bzhi nag pa sogs nas yab yum thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /bar gong bzhin/ gtso bo lnga'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ oṃ tram̐ ām̐ khām̐ rnams yongs su gyur pa las/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ ral gri rnams hūm̐ oṃ tram̐ ām̐ khām̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las ye shes sems dpa' rang rang dang 'dra ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che pad+ma ral gri rnams hūm̐ oṃ tram̐ ām̐ khām̐ gis mtshan pa/

de ltar gtso bo sems dpa' sum brtsegs su bsgoms nas/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs/ de nas/ thugs ka'i ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i 'od zer gyis snod thams cad gzhal yas khang / bcud thams cad mkha' 'gro lnga'i lha tshogs su byas par bsam mo/ /gnyis pa ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya ba ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas mkha' 'gro lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rten dang brten par bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs la/ gong tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /sogs yid las byung bas mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes te/ /khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan cing / /snying rje'i shugs kyis sems can phan mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma spros pa rdo rje sgrub pa'i yid/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes/ /zhes pas bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las gau rī lcags kyu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te ye shes pa rnams kyi thugs kar reg pa'i tshul du byas pas ye shes pa rnams bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du dgug par bsam la/ lus kyis lcags kyu'i phyag rgya bcas te/ ngag tu/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān mahā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ de bzhin du tsau rī ser mo zhags pa thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros te/ ye shes pa rnams kyi mgrin par reg pa'i tshul byas/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo rten dang brten par bcas pa rang gi dam tshig gi 'khor lo la bcug par bsam la/ zhags pa'i phyag rgya dang /

oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra we sha ya hūm̐/ bai tā li dmar mo lcags sgrog thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros nas dkyil 'khor pa thams cad kyi zhabs la lcags sgrog gis reg pa'i tshul byas pas ye shes dang dam tshig pa dbyer med gcig tu gyur par mos la lcags sgrog gi phyag rgya dang / oṃ badz+ra bai tā li ban+dha baṃ/ ghasma ri dril bu thogs pa dpag tu med ba spros te gzhal yas khang gi phyi nang thams cad gang bas lha rnams dgyes pa khyad par can bskyed cing / rang ye shes kyi 'khor lo'i ngo bor nga rgyal brtan po bskyed nas dril bu'i phyag rgya dang / ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes brjod de sgrub pa'o/ /gsum pa skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ de nas/ nyer sgrub ni/ lha thams cad kyi mig tu maṃ las gti mug rdo rje ma dkar mo/ rna bar daṃ las zhe sdang rdo rje ma sngon mo/ snar paṃ las ser sna rdo rje ma ser mo/ lce la raṃ las 'dod chags rdo rje ma dmar mo/ dpral bar aṃ las phrag dog rdo rje ma ljang khu/ snying khar naṃ las bdag med rnal 'byor ma nag mo/ spyi bor oṃ las sku rdo rje ma dkar mo/ mgrin par āḥlas gsung rdo rje ma dmar mo/ snying khar hūm̐ las thugs rdo rje ma nag mo/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa/ gru mo na kha ṭāṃ ga 'dzin cing ro'i steng na skyil krung phyed pa'i gar gyis ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsam la/ oṃ khe tsa rī badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ bhū tsa rī badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ oṃ pā tā la ba si nī badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod de byin gyis brlab bo/ /gsum pa sgrub pa chen po dbang bskur ba mi bskyod pa'i yan lag ni/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang bskur gyi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga yum bzhi byang chub sems dpa' brgyad lha mo drug

khro bo bcu/ 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes spyan drangs/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis mchod/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ser sna rdo rje bdag la stsol/ /'dod chags rdo rje bdag la skyobs/ /yid dang phrag dog chen po kun/ /rdo rje kun gyi dam tshig mgon/ /las rnams thams cad sgrub mdzad pa/ /rdo rje can kun bdag dges mdzod/ /ces pas bstod la/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /sogs gong bzhin gyi gsol ba btab pas sangs rgyas de rnams khro chags kyi rnam pa he ru ka zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug par gyur nas bdag la dbang bskur bar bsam la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /zhes sogs nas/ ṣīñtsa hūm̐ gi bar gong bzhin/ zhes gsung zhing / gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ma gsum/ gzugs rdo rje ma la sogs pa lnga ste/ rig ma brgyad kyis bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas lha thams cad kyi spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas dbang bskur/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rig ma rnams kyis mchod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rdo rje can yab yum la mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i rigs rnam pa lngas dbur brgyan pa'i mi bskyod pa'i spyi bor rdo rje nag po chen po/ gtso bo yab yum gzhan bzhi la rang rang gi rigs kyi bdag pos dbu brgyan pa'i rnam snang gi spyi bor 'khor lo dkar po/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi spyi bor rin po che ser po zur brgyad pa/ 'od dpag med kyi spyi bor pad+ma dmar po/ don yod grub pa'i spyi bor ral gri ljang gu/

'khor gyi lha mo rnams la rang rang gi gtso bos dbur brgyan/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo ma bzhi'i lcags kyu ma la rnam par snang mdzad/ zhags pa ma la rin chen 'byung ldan/ lcags sgrog ma la 'od dpag med/ dril bu ma la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes nga rgyal bzung ngo / /bzhi pa bdud rtsi myang ba 'od dpag tu med pa'i yan lag ni/ mdun du bdud rtsi dngos su bshams pa'am/ med na bsam pas kyang rung ste/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes pas bgegs bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dho sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu bdungs pa lta bu g.yo ba'i ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum 'bar bas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du a las thod pa dum bu gsum pa mdog dkar ba/ dpral ba rang la bstan pa/ de'i steng du yang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor nya gang ba/ zla ba'i steng du shar du go las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha sha lnga po re re'i steng du shar du bh+rūṃ las dri chen/ lhor āṃ las rak+ta/ nub tu dz+rīṃ las byang chub kyi sems/ byang du khāṃ las sha chen gyi dwangs ma/ dbus su hūm̐ las dri chen/ de dag gi shar du bh+rūṃ me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor āṃ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+rīṃ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du khaṃ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes su mos pa byas/ yang de thams cad thabs shes las byung bar mtshon pa'i phyir/ sngar gyi zla ba'i steng / zla ba'i mthar g.yon bskor gyis a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ g.yas bskor gyis/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzña nya/

ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ de rnams kyi steng gi nam mkha' la oṃ dkar po mgo bo thur du bltas pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa lte ba la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pa rlung gi ba dan la phog pas rlung g.yos me sbar bas sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga rnams bskol zhing 'od du zhu ba'i rlangs pa gyen la song bas/ oṃ dang rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag yang hūm̐ las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs ka nas yang dag pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rnams he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i rnam par byon te/ rdo rje'i lte ba'i hūm̐ la thim pas rdo rje brjid dang ldan par gyur/ rdo rje nyi ma oṃ dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung ba 'od du zhu nas sngar gyi bdud rtsi rnams dang gnyis su med par gyur te kha dog dang dri dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlabs/ lha thams cad kyi lce la rdo rje nas 'bras tsam bsam la/ de nas 'od byung nas bdud rtsi gsol bas tshim zhing dges par mos te/ dngos su bdud rtsi yod na lce la myangs shing / oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa dā na badz+ra swa bha wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing nga rgyal bzung ngo / /lnga pa mchod pa don yod grub pa'i yan lag ni ye shes sems dpa'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i lha mo brgyad kyis dkyil 'khor pa thams cad la mchod par mos te/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ nas/ g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ bar/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta pū dza badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing nga rgyal bzung ngo / /drug pa bstod pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi yan lag ni lha mo de rnams kyis dkyil 'khor ba thams cad la bstod par bsam zhing /

khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyi mchog brnyes te/ /khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan cing / /snying rje'i shugs kyis sems can phan mdzad pa/ /sgyu ma spros pa rdo rje sgrub pa'i yid/ /he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta stū ti badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing nga rgyal bzung ngo / /gnyis pa rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni man ngag thob pa rnams kyis gtum mo 'khor lo bzhi'i dmigs pa rgyas pa bsgom ste man ngag las 'byung ba ltar ro/ /ting nge 'dzin gsum gyi 'ching sogs ni gzhan nu rtogs par bya'o/ /rjes rdzogs par byed pa lam gyi yan lag la dang po bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni de ltar rim pa gnyis bsgom pas skyo na sngags bzla bar bya ste/ phreng ba byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ thod phreng dang bo dhi tsit+ta la sogs pa las dang rjes su mthun pa'i phreng ba mtshan nyid dang ldan pa bzung la/ rang lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas phreng ba a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ rang yi dam du gsal ba'i lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo rnams pad+ma 'dab ma lnga pa/ lag pa'i mthil du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la a ā/ i ī/ u ū/ ṛ ṝ/ l̥ l̥̄/ e ai/ o au/ aṃ āḥ g.yon du bskor ba'i lte bar āḥ lag pa g.yas pa'i sor mo lnga rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ lag pa'i mthil du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzña nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣaḥ g.yon skor du 'khor ba'i lte bar/ hūm̐/ lag pa gnyis pad kor sngon du 'gro bas bsangs sbyangs byas pa'i phreng ba blangs te/ lag pa gnyis thal mo sbyar ba'i dbus su bzhag der/ bdud rtsi yi ge suṃ dkar po 'od 'phro bar bsam/ rdo rje dang pad+ma snyoms par zhugs pas byang chub kyi sems suṃ la khyab/ de ā li dang kā li la khyab/ de phreng ba dang gnyis su med par gyur par bsam la/

ngag tu/ oṃ pa de pa de ma hā dzñā naṃ sarba bud+dha ma yaṃ bha be te hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho hoḥ.ā khaṃ swāhā/ zhes 'di dang po byin gyis rlob dus phreng 'khor gcig bzlas pa nam byed dus kyang gsum la sogs pa bzlas na mthu dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /zhes rje btsun rtse mo'i dgongs pa gtsor bton gyi mthong brgyud phyag len kyang 'di'o/ /bzlas pa'i dmigs pa ni/ gtso bo rnams kyi sngags bzla ba'i dus su rang rang gi yum gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las sngags kyi 'phreng ba byung / yum gyi zhal nas 'thon/ yab kyi zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ rdo rje'i lam nas byung ste yum gyi pad+mar zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud de yang sngar bzhin du 'khod/ sngags kyi 'od zer gyis phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rgyud bskul bar bsgom zhing bzla/ 'khor gyi sngags bzlas pa'i dus su sngar bzhin 'khor ba la dmigs nas bzlas pa'i sngags kyi 'od zer lha gang la phog pa de bdag gi dbang du gyur par bsam zhing 'phrin las la bskul bar bsgom zhing bzla/ 'khor gyi sngags bzla ba'i dus su sngar bzhin 'khor ba la dmigs nas bzlas pa sngags kyi 'od zer lha gang la phog pa de bdag gi dbang du gyur par bsam zhing phrin las bskur bar bsgom/ sngags kyi 'od zer zhi ba la dkar po la sogs pa las dang rjes su mthun pa ste bzlas pa'i sngags ni/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dha ra ya dha ra ya/ mar+dha mar+dha badz+ra dhṛkā phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ sha shwa ta pa ra ma sha shwa ta/ e h+ye hi dzi na dzika phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra sūr+ya ta mo bi dha ma hā sa ma ya satwaṃ a haṃ rat+na dhṛka phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra sa dharmaḥs ma ya satwaṃ/ hu lu hu lu a ro l̥kā phaṭa swāhā/ yab lnga'i sngags so/ /oṃ āḥdwe ṣa ra ti hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥmo ha ra ti hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ aḥrat+na ra ti hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥrā ga ra ti hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/

oṃ āḥbadz+ra ra ti hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ yum lnga'i 'o/ /oṃ āḥgāṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥgāṃ badz+ra gau rī hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥtsaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥtsaṃ badz+ra tsau rī hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥbaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥbaṃ badz+ra bai tā lī hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥghaṃ hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ oṃ āḥghaṃ badz+ra ghasma rī hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ de bzhin du/ oṃ āḥbadz+ra zhes thams cad kyi 'go dang / paṃ puk+ka sī hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ thams cad kyi mjug tu sbyar bar gyi sngags mi 'dra ba ni/ shaṃ sha wa ri/ laṃ tsaṇ+ḍa li/ ḍaṃ ḍom+bhi ni/ rdo rje can gyi lha mo rnams kyi mtshan gyi sngags so/ /saṃ san+ta she pāṃ pā sha ni/ baṃ ba gu re/ oṃ aṅku re/ paṃ puṣ+paṃ/ dhaṃ dhū paṃ/ dāṃ dī paṃ/ gaṃ gan+dhaṃ phan pa'i lha mo rnams kyi'o/ /saṃ sūr+ya haste/ dāṃ dī paṃ/ raṃ rat+na ā lo ke trāṃ taṃ ṭi ka re/ lāṃ lā s+ye/ hāṃ ha s+ye/ gāṃ gī ti/ nī nṛ ti/ rdo rje nyi ma'i lha mo rnams kyi'o/ /paṃ pad+me/ dhaṃ dharmo da ya/ s+phaṃ s+pho ṭe/ shāṃ shī she waṃ wa se/ bāṃ bī ṇi/ maṃ murdzi/ maṃ mṛ taṃ gi pad+ma gar dbang gi lha mo rnams kyi'o/ /taṃ ta la/ kaṃ kiñtsa/ kaṃ ki pa ṭa/ paṃ pa ṭa dha ra ni/ laṃ lo tsa ni/ maṃ mā ma kī paṃ paṇ+ḍa ra wā sī nī/ tāṃ tā ri/ rta'i rgyal po'i lha mo rnams kyi'o/ /aṃ aṅku she paṃ pā she s+phaṃ s+pho ṭe/ ghaṃ ghaṇ+ḍe/ sgo ma bzhi'i sa bon dang mtshan gyi sngags re re rnams ci rigs par bzlas pa'i mthar/ 'phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug la/ bde bar gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las dang bcas pa thams cad kyis bdag dang sems can thams cad la byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ myur du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ de nas mchog la dag pa dran pa khyad par ro/ /gsungs pas dag pa dran pa ni/ snying rje yi ni spyan dag dmar/ /spyan gyi rnam dag rdo rje gsum/

/zhal rnams rnam par brgyad po yin/ /phyag ni stong pa bcu drug yin/ /bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yis ni/ /zhabs ni bzhi par brjod pa'o/ /phyag rgya yi ni sangs rgyas lnga/ /khro bo gdug pa 'dul ba po/ /bden pa rnam pa bzhi po ni/ /rus pa ru ni yongs gyur pa'o/ /gzugs phung rdo rje ma ru gyur/ /tshor ba gsang ba'i gau rī ma/ /'du shes de bzhin chu ma ste/ /'du byed rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /rnam shes nyid ni bdag med ma/ /phung po don dam par na med/ /skye mched drug ni rnam dag phyir/ /de rnams yan lag drug tu gyur/ /zhe sdang rdo rje 'khor lo ma/ /chu ma ro yi rdo rje yin/ /phrag dog rdo rje gti mug ma/ /rdo rje rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /sa rnams gsang ba'i gau rī ma/ /yid la bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /sa ni puk+ka sī ru bshad/ /chu khams ri khrod ma ru brjod/ /me ni gtum mor shes par bya/ /rlung ni g.yung mor rab tu grags/ /gzugs la dkar mo rab tu bshad/ /sgra la chom rkun ma rab grags/ /dri yi cha la ro langs ma/ /ro la ghasma rī yi gzugs/ /reg la sa spyod ma ru brjod/ /chos kyi khams la mkha' spyod ma'o/ /gtso bo lnga'i phyag mtshan gyi dag pa ni/ glo dang dbugs dang de bzhin smyo/ /khong skam mdze dang rkang shu dang / /mtsher pa mchin pa'i rang bzhin kyang / /glang po la sogs rab tu grags/ /rdzi ma byi dang so nad dang / /mkhris pa khrag dang de bzhin rlung / /bad kan 'dzag dang lus gas dang / /skyab sbab 'bras ni rma bya sogs/ /rkang bab tshil na rlig skrangs dang / /sgyu ma 'phel dang lhog pa dang / /'khru dang rims nad rab gas ni/ /ka ran+da sogs rab tu grags/ /brjed byed dang ni pho mtshan lug /chu sri ba dang rdo chu can/ /gzhang nad bkren dang bkres nad dang / /mig ser dom la sogs pa'o/ /rlung dang mkhris pa ma zhu ba'o/ /sgrib g.yogs rab rib gcin sri ba/ /gzhog phyed na dang lkog 'bras dang /

/rlung rgyas gza' lhag la sogs pa'o/ /zhes dang rgyas par na rgyud las gsungs pa'i lha so so'i phyag mtshan gyi dag pa dang / de bzhin du gzhal yas khang gi dag pa yang dran par bya/ mdor na gzhal yas khang ni byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun dang / dur khrod brgyad ni lus kyi bu ga brgyad dang / bstod pa dang smad pa la sogs pa 'jig rten gyi chos brgyad dag pa yin no/ /zhes mos pa tsam byas la/ bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor la mchod bstod 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las ā las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung / mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khāṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nī wi te hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ne swāhā/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ nas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ gi bar byin gyis brlabs/ pad kor sngon du 'gro bas so so'i phyag rgya gong bzhin dang bcas pas/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā ka ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khāṃ swāhā/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ nī wi ti hūm̐ khāṃ swāhā/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ne swāhā/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhāṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhū+ām̐/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra dhū pe+e āḥhū+ām̐/

oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhū+ām̐/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhū+ām̐/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ nai wi d+ye āḥhū+ām̐/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra shap+ta ā ཿhū+ām̐/ rol chen dang bcas pas mchod/ hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ ām̐ khām̐ mam̐ lam̐ rām̐ pam̐ tām̐ gām̐ tsām̐ sogs sa bon rnams kyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes sogs kyis nang mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis yid mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma sogs kyis bstod/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas khams gsum snod bcud thams cad dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i rnam par gnas pa la phog de thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te srung ba'i 'khor lo bsrung 'khor grol nyin bar mi bsdu gsung la thim/ de dur khrod brgyad la thim/ de phyi'i gzhal yas khang la thim/ phyi'i gzhal yas khang nang gi gzhal yas khang la thim/ nang gi gzhal yas khang lnga po rang rang gi 'khor gyi lha mo brgyad la thim/ lha mo rnams rang rang gi gtso bo'i zhal la thim/ phyogs kyi mkha' 'gro bzhi'i yum yab la thim/ yab bzhi po dbus kyi gtso bo la thim/ zhes pas dkyil 'khor bsdus te rang nyid rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i nga rgyal gyis sa lha'i tshom bu/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wā sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i steng du baṃ las sa'i lha mo sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa thugs kar 'dzin pa rin po che sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis sa 'og nas sa'i lha mo oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pri thi wi de wī oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du mtshan sngags la zhal bsil 'thor 'thung mchod yon gyi sngags rnams kyang rigs 'gre btags/

oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥnas/ wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥzhes pa'i bar gyis 'gug gzhug dang / de'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma bar gyis skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ slar yang thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ nas/ /khyed kyis 'di la dbang bskur stsol/ /zhes pa'i bar gyis gsol ba btab pas dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ sangs rgyas rnams ni nas/ ṣīñtsa hūm̐ gi bar dang / zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang / dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ pri thi wi de wī oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin du/ oṃ pri thi wi de wī oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ gi bar rigs 'gre/ dharma ra ṇi sogs rol chen bcas pa mchod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod phul la/ de nas gtor ma la chab bran te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ lan gcig dang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin du byas te/ oṃ pri thi wi de wī oṃ a kā ro mu khaṃ/ sarba dharmā ṇaṃ/ ād+ya nut+pan+na twata/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ lan gsum gyis gtor ma phul/ rdo rje spos reng bcus g.yab/ dril bu dkrol zhing / skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyi/ /sa dang pha rol phyin pa la/ /lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur/ /dngos grub thams cad thob bya'i phyir/ /bdag gis dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /zhes lan gsum brjod la/ rdo rje thugs ka dang dril bu dkrol bzhin pas/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams kyi thugs dgongs rdzogs pa dang / nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du phyag rgya chen po mchog gi dngos grub mkha' 'gro lnga'i go 'phang thob par bya ba'i phyir du sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor chen po bzhengs te sgrub cing mchod pa dang /

bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'am/ slob ma gzhug cing dbang bskur bar 'tshal na/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing las kyi dngos grub kyang stsol bar mdzad du gsol/ lag pa g.yas pa sa la reg la/ oṃ badz+ra muḥsa'i lha mo sa de nyid la thim par bsam/ lha sta gon ni/ mdun bskyed kyi tshom bu rnams la dmigs nas rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis nam mkha'i dbyings su sems kyi snang ba las byung ba'i paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i nas/ ye shes kyi me kha dog lnga 'bar bas bskor bar gyur/ ces pa'i bar dang / oṃ me dī nī badz+ri bha wa ban+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ lan gsum dang / oṃ rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ lan gsum/ de lta bu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus su e las chos kyi 'byung gnas phyogs kun nas gru gsum pa/ gdengs ka che ba gyen du phyogs pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba rtsa ba thur du zug pa yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i nang du yaṃ las rlung gi nas/ rgya dang tshad yongs su ma chad pa ye shes kyi snang ba las grub cing rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba'i gzhal yas khang par gyur/ bar/ gzhal yas khang pa'i phyi rol rdo rje'i rwa ba'i nang du dur khrod chen po brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i shing brgyad/ shing gi rtsa ba la gnas pa'i phyogs skyong brgyad/ shing gi yal ga la gnas pa'i zhing skyong brgyad/ steng gi nam mkha' la gnas pa'i sprin brgyad/ de dag la gnas pa'i klu brgyad/ gzhan yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten brgyad nas/ 'dab ma brgyad po rnams dang phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi sgo bzhir zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / ro'i gdan zhes pa'i bar bdag bskyed sor bzhag brjod la/ de nas/ hūm̐ shrī he ru ka nā ma/ rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo ba zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/

rtsa ba'i zhal sngo/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis nag pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhis mdzes pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor rdo rje nag pos mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas pa rnams na glang po che/ rta/ bong bu/ nas/ nor sbyin rnams 'dzin pa bar bdag bskyed bzhin la/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po rdzogs pa lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya drug gis brgyan pa zhabs g.yas gnyis brkyang ba'i brla la g.yon gnyis bskum pa'i sor mo rnams gtad pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs shing gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan pa/ māṃ mā ma ki nā ma/ de'i pang na yum mā ma ki sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gcer bu zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ gaṃ gau rī nā ma/ shar du gau rī dkar mo g.yas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ tsaṃ tsau rī nā ma/ lhor tsau rī ser mo g.yas rdo rje zhags pa 'dzin pa/ baṃ bai tā lī nā ma/ nub tu bai tā lī dmar mo g.yas rdo rje lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ ghaṃ ghasma rī nā ma/ byang du ghasma rī ljang khu g.yas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ paṃ puk+ka sī nā ma/ byang shar du puk+ka sī nag mo g.yas ri rab 'dzin pa/ shaṃ sha ba rī nā ma/ shar lhor sha wa rī dkar mo g.yas byang chub kyi sems kyis gang ba'i bum pa 'dzin pa/ laṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī nā ma/ lho nub tu gdol pa ma sngon mo g.yas me thab 'dzin pa/ ḍaṃ ḍoṃ bhi gi nā ma/

nub byang du g.yung mo ljang khu g.yas rlung gis bskyod pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa/ oṃ shrī he ru ka nā ma/ phan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rtag pa sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar ba/ steng zhal dud kha zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis nag pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhis mdzes pa/ dbu skra ser po brdzes pa spyi bor 'khor lo dkar pos mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas pa rnams na rma bya/ ma he/ chu srin ma ka ra nas/ bya bzhad rnams 'dzin pa bar/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po rdzogs pa lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang nas/ dgu dang ldan pa bar/ laṃ lo tsa nī nā ma/ de'i pang na yum sangs rgyas spyan ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa bar/ 'dab ma brgyad la saṃ san+dha sha nā ma/ shar du skam pa ma nag mo g.yas skam pa 'dzin pa/ pāṃ pā sha nī nā ma/ lhor zhags pa ma ser mo g.yas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ baṃ ba gu ra nā ma/ nub tu dol zlum ma dmar mo g.yas nya rgya 'dzin pa/ aṃ aṅku sha nā ma/ byang du lcags kyu ma ljang gu g.yas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ paṃ puṣ+pe nā ma/ byang shar du me tog ma dkar mo g.yas me tog 'dzin pa/ dhaṃ dhu paṃ nā ma/ shar lhor bdug spos ma dud kha g.yas spos snod 'dzin pa/ daṃ dī paṃ nā ma/ lho nub tu mar me ma ser mo g.yas mar me 'dzin pa/ gaṃ gan+dha nā ma/ nub byang du dbyug pa ma dmar mo g.yas dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa/ trāṃ shrī he ru ka nā ma/ rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rin chen rgyal po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal ser/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar/ steng zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis nag pa mche ba gtsigs pa/

spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhis mdzes pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa spyi bor rin po che ser po zur brgyad pas mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas pa rnams na bya ka ran+da/ ngur pa/ lug nas/ mtha' yas rnams 'dzin pa bar/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po rdzogs pa lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang nas/ ldan pa bar/ raṃ rat+na tā re nā ma/ de'i pang na yum rin chen sgrol ma sku mdog ser mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa bar/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ saṃ sūr+ya hasta nā ma/ shar du nyi lag ma dkar mo g.yas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa/ dāṃ dī paṃ nā ma/ lhor mar me ma sngo dmar g.yas mar me'i mchod sdong 'dzin pa/ rāṃ rat+na ā lo ke nā ma/ nub tu rin chen skar mda' ma ser mo g.yas rin po che 'dzin pa/ taṃ ti tri ka ra nā ma/ byang du glog lag ma ljang khu g.yas glog gi 'phreng ba 'dzin pa/ lāṃ lā s+ye nā ma/ byang shar du sgeg mo dkar mo g.yas khu tshur sked par 'jog pa/ haṃ ha s+ye nā ma/ shar lhor 'phreng ba ma dmar mo g.yas so'i phreng ba kha 'gram g.yas su 'dzin pa/ gāṃ gī ti nā ma/ lho nub tu glu ma ser mo g.yas kha nas tshig 'byin pa'i tshul byed pa/ nāṃ nī tri nā ma/ nub byang du gar ma ljang khu g.yas gar gyi tshul byed pa/ oṃ shrī he ru ka nā ma/ pad+ma gar gyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rta mgrin sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhal bzhi pa rtsa ba'i zhal dmar/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba/ steng zhal dud kha zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis nag pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhis mdzes pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa spyi bor pad+ma dmar pos mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas pa rnams na dom/ bya rgod/ bse nas/ phag rnams 'dzin pa bar/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po rdzogs pa lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang nas/
