ldan pa bar/ paṃ paṇ+ḍa ra nā ma/ de'i pang na yum gos dkar mo sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa bar/ 'dab ma brgyad la/ paṃ pad+ma nā ma/ shar du pad+ma can dkar mo g.yas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ dhaṃ dharma da ya nā ma/ lhor chos 'byung ma ser mo g.yas chos 'byung 'dzin pa/ s+phaṃ s+pho ṭa nā ma/ nub tu lcags sgrog ma nag mo g.yas lcags sgrog 'dzin pa/ shāṃ shī she nā ma/ byang du 'khyud ma ljang khu g.yas 'khyud pa'i tshul byed pa/ wāṃ wā se nā ma/ byang shar du gling bu ma ser mo g.yas gling bu 'dzin pa/ wāṃ wī ṇi nā ma/ shar lhor pi wang ma dkar mo g.yas pi wang 'dzin pa/ māṃ murdza nā ma/ lho nub tu rnga zlum ma ljang khu g.yas rnga zlum 'dzin pa/ māṃ mṛ taṅga nā ma/ nub byang du rdza rnga ma dkar mo g.yas rdza rnga 'dzin pa/ khāṃ shrī he ru ka nā ma/ rta'i rgyal po'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rta mchog in+d+ra nī la ltar ljang ba zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal rta'i gdong pa can ljang khu/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba/ steng zhal dud kha/ lhag ma gnyis gnyis nag pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhis mdzes pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa spyi bor ral gri ljang khus mdzes pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas pa rnams na gza' lhag phur bu/ mjug ring nas/ lha ma yin stobs ldan rnams 'dzin pa bar/ dbu re re la mi mgo skam po rdzogs pa lnga lnga'i dbu rgyan dang nas/ ldan pa bar/ traṃ tā re nā ma/ de'i pang na yum dam tshig sgrol ma sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma spyan gsum mche ba brtsigs pa nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa 'dab ma brgyad la/ tāṃ ta la nā ma/ shar du sgo lcags ma dkar mo g.yas sgo lcags 'dzin pa/ kaṃ kiñtsa nā ma/ lhor lde kyog ma ser mo g.yas lde kyog 'dzin pa/

kāṃ ki pa ṭa nā ma/ nub tu sgo glegs ma dmar mo g.yas sgo glegs 'dzin pa/ waṃ wasatra dha ri ṇi nā ma/ byang du gos 'dzin ma sngon mo g.yas gos 'dzin pa/ laṃ lo tsa ni nā ma/ byang shar du spyan ma dkar mo g.yas 'khor lo'i lte bar spyan gyis mtshan pa 'dzin pa/ maṃ mā ma ki nā ma/ shar lhor mā ma ki sngon mo g.yas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ paṃ paṇ+ḍa ra wā si nī nā ma/ lho nub tu gos dkar mo dmar mo g.yas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ tāṃ tā re nā ma/ nub byang du sgrol ma ljang khu g.yas ut+pa la 'dzin pa/ aṃ aṅku sha nā ma/ phyi'i shar sgor lcags kyu ma dkar mo g.yas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ pāṃ pā sha nā ma/ lho sgor zhags pa ma ser mo g.yas zhags pa 'dzin pa/ s+phaṃ s+pho ṭa nā ma/ nub sgor lcags sgrog ma dmar mo g.yas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ ghaṃ ghaṇ+ḍe nā ma/ byang sgor dril bu ma ljang khu g.yas dril bu 'dzin pa/ 'khor gyi lha mo thams cad kyang nas/ zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pa'i skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /bar bdag bskyed bzhin brjod/ gtso bo lnga'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ āṃ khaṃ rnams yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje 'khor lo rin po che pad+ma ral gri rnams hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ āṃ khaṃ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las ye shes sems dpa' rang dang 'dra ba'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'/ rdo rje/ 'khor lo/ rin po che/ pad+ma/ ral gri rnams hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ āṃ khaṃ gis mtshan pa nas/ dril bu ma la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan bar bdag bskyed bzhin brjod/ 'di'i ye shes pa spyan 'dren gyi dus chu bzhi'i sngags phyag rgya byed pa dang bstun las kyi rdo rjes zhabs bsil dang zhal bsil dang mdun gyi snod gsum du phul/ dkyil 'khor g.yas kyis mchod ting gnyis kha phub 'thor 'thung nas ku sha'i 'thor yab kyis gtor mchod yon kyang mdun gyi snod du blug la ting kha phub bo/

/de nas mchod pa rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du mchod rdzas rnams hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ de nas phyi'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ thog mar lag pa gnyis dku g.yon par rdo rje khu tshur kha sprad la bcings te/ g.yas pa'i mthe'u chung dang g.yon pa'i mdzub mo nas rim bzhin bkrol te rnam lnga 'dod pa'i skor ba byas la/ me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /bdag gi dad pas 'bul lags kyi/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ ces me tog phul/ tshal dag ro ni phan pa dang / /gang zhig dri dang bdug spos mchog /tshig rkang phyi ma gnyis dang sngags kyi thog mtha' 'di bzhin 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar bar bya'o/ /dhū paṃ bdug spos shangs la/ srin po 'joms shing dag byed la/ /dge zhing mun pa rnam sel ba/ /ā lo ke mar me spyan la/ 'di ni dri bzang dge ba ste/ /dag pa'i skye gnas las dag pa/ /gan+dhe dri thugs kar/ sman rnams bcud gtsang yid gar 'ong / /sngags kyi zhal zas bshos 'di dag /nai wi d+ye zhal du/ dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i rol mo 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dgyes par mdzod/ /shap+ta mjug tu rol mo 'bud dkrol dang / oṃ badz+ra dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs brjod zhes pas snyan la 'bul lo/ /chu bzhi ye shes pa spyan drangs pa la phul nas 'dir me tog sogs kyis mchod pa ni lugs 'di'i khyad chos so/ /gos zung / oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsangs/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/

stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos srab pa 'jam pa yang ba lha re re la zung du sbyar ba dang ldan par gyur/ zhes dang rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis bkon pa'i tshul bya zhing / srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos/ /mi bskyod rdo rje'i sku la 'bul/ /mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul gyis/ /bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra wasatra ya āḥhūm̐/ zhes dbul/ bdud rtsi'i mchod pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrīḥ zhes lan gsum brjod pas byin rlabs dran pa tsam byas la/ yang lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyi rtse mo sbyar te g.yon du lan gsum bskor zhing dbus nas blangs te steng du gtor zhing / oṃ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo/ mkhyen pa'i ye shes/ brtse ba'i thugs rje/ mdzad pa'i phrin las bsam gyis mi khyab pa mnga' ba drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ bir+wa pa/ ḍom+bhi he ru ka a la la badz+ra/ nags khrod pa/ gar+bha ri pa/ bsod snyoms pa/ dza ya shrī/ mi thub zla ba/ dpa' bo rdo rje/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ mnga' ris pa gsal ba'i snying po/ 'khon sgyi chu ba/ rje sa skya pa chen po/ ne tso sbal ston/ ta stag so ba rin chen don grub/ gan pa ston dar/ gan pa se ston/ gan pa chos rgyal/ gan pa dbang rin/ gan pa rin rgyal/ chos rje bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje sangs rgyas dpal grub/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' brtan pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/

shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ mtshungs med dam chos bsam grub/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ chos rje bstan 'dzin lhun grub/ 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub/ rdo rje 'chang sangs rgyas ye shes/ drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa dpal sa skya pa chen po ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yang na kho bos gong dkar rdo rje 'chang chos dbang rgya mtshor zhus pa ltar na/ rdo rje 'chang nas/ chos rje bla ma yan gong bzhin la/ de nas/ bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ mkhan chen seng ge dpal/ brag thog pa bsod nams bzang po/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa/ mkhas grub rnam rgyal rin chen/ yongs 'dzin shākya kun dga'/ mtshungs med ye shes dbang po/ rje btsun tshul khrims bkra shis/ chos rje dge ba'i dbang po/ chos rje rin chen rgya mtsho/ mkhan chen ngag dbang sbyin pa/ gar dbyangs pa ngag dbang rab brtan/ rnam grol rdo rje 'chang chos dbang rgya mtsho/ des kho bo la'o/ /gzhan yang brgyud tshul kha shas yod do/ /gzhan yang dbang bskur/ rgyud bshad/ man ngag nod/ chos kyi 'brel pa thob pa'i bla ma dam pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ ām̐ kham̐ mām̐ lam̐ ram̐ sam̐ tām̐/ gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ pam̐ sam̐ bam̐ ām̐ pam̐ dham̐ dām̐ gham̐/ sam̐ dam̐ ram̐ tām̐ lam̐ ham̐ gam̐ nām̐/ pam̐ dham̐ s+pham̐ sham̐ wam̐ bam̐ mam̐ lam̐/ tam̐ kam̐ kam̐ sam̐ lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tām̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ mkha' 'gro lnga rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang bya ba'i rgyud/ spyod pa'i rgyud/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud/ rnal 'byor chen po bla na med pa'i rgyud de/ rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba'i yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ rang gi lce rtse smin mtshams/ spyi gtsug rnams su thig le byas la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/

zhes pas lus kyi lha rnams mchod par bsam/ lha sta gon gyi skabs 'dir gtor ma rnams la bar phud bran la/ oṃ shrī ma hā kā lā yā oṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ shrī dharma pā la tsa turmu kha ya oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang chos 'khor srung zhing bstan pa skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i dpal mgon dam tshig can rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gnas dang nye ba'i gnas/ zhing dang nye ba'i zhing / tshan+dho dang nye ba'i tshan+dho/ 'du ba dang nye ba'i 'du ba/ 'thung gcod dang nye ba'i 'thung gcod/ dur khrod dang nye ba'i dur khrod/ yul sum cu so gnyis/ gnas nyi shu rtsa bzhi/ dur khrod chen po brgyad na bzhugs pa'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma bsam gyis mi khyab pa sprul pa'i sku 'gro ba sems can gyi don mdzad pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad/ pho nya gnas las skyes pa/ rigs las skyes pa/ sngags las skyes pa/ las las skyes pa'i mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang / gnas gsum gyi rdo rje mkha' 'gro rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gzhan yang gnod sbyin/ srin po/ 'byung po/ yi dwags/ sha za/ smyo byed/ brjed byed/ ma mo/ zhing skyong / pho nya/ 'phrog ma/ grub pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bod khams skyong bar zhal gyis bzhes pa'i bstan ma bcu gnyis 'khor dang bcas pa rnams dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag grong bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'gro ba rigs drug lam rgyud lnga/ skye gnas rnam pa bzhis bsdus pa'i sems can thams cad tshim zhing zag pa med pa'i bde bas rgyud gang nas myur du bla na med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob pa'i skal ba dang ldan par gyur cig oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes dang rang gis kyang myangs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a mṛ ta swa da na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod/ de nas yid las byung ba'i mchod pa nyi shu ni/ lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur kha gyen du bstan pa'i phyag rgya dang /

gzugs mdzes mthong bas mi ngoms reg na bde/ /yid 'phrog snyems pa'i tshul 'dzin sgeg mo yis/ /zhing khams 'di dang rab 'byams zhing khams rnams/ /bkang ste dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra lā s+ye pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ tshigs rkang rjes ma gnyis dang sngags kyi thog mtha' rnams 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar te/ lag gnyis rdo rje khu tshur gyis 'phreng ba 'dzin tshul dang / in+d+ra nī la la sogs 'jig rten na/ /shin tu dkon pa'i rin chen 'phreng 'dzin gyis/ /badz+ra mā l+ye/ rdo rje khu tshur gyi kha nas tshig 'byin tshul dang / drug gi rjes su skyes sogs snyan pa'i dbyangs/ /thos nas tshim pa len byed glu ma yis/ /badz+ra gī tī lag gnyis pad kor g.yon du g.yas su bskor nas spyi bor rdo rje thal mo sbyar ba dang / gcig nyid du ma'i tshul du rab bstan nas/ /'gro la dga' bskyed gar gyi mchod pa yis/ /badz+ra nṛ te/ g.yon pa'i thal mo gyen du bslang / g.yas pas pi wang bsgreng tshul dang / rgyud dang lpags pa skyes bu'i rtsol ba sogs/ /du ma'i rten 'brel las byung pi waṃ sgras/ /badz+ra wī ṇi/ lag gnyis kyis sor mo g.yas phyogs su gling bu bsgyur ba'i tshul dang / gang gi lag pa bskyod pa'i khyad par las/ /sna tshogs rnar snyan bskyed byed gling bu yis/ /badz+ra wāṃ s+ye/ lag gnyis kyis thal mo mdun du rdza rnga brdung ba'i tshul dang / mdzes pa'i gzugs ldan skad snyan du ma yis/ /ma lus 'gro ba tshim byed rdza rnga'i sgra/ /badz+ra mṛ tāṃ ga lag pa g.yas g.yon du gdengs te rnga pa ṭa ha brdung ba'i tshul dang / dbyibs legs drwa bas legs spras yid du 'ong / /shin tu brjid pa'i sgra 'byin rnga zlum gyis/ /badz+ra pa ṭa ha/ me tog gi phyag rgya dang / gser sogs rin chen las grub 'dab stong ldan/ /mdangs bkra yid 'ong dri ldan me tog gis/

/badz+ra puṣ+pe/ bdug pa'i phyag rgya dang / a dkar nag sogs lhan cig skyes pa dang / /sbyar ba las byung bdug pa'i sprin tshogs kyis/ /badz+ra dhū pe/ mar me'i phyag rgya dang / nyi zla nor bu sgron me'i 'od la sogs/ /mun pa sel byed snang ba'i tshogs kun gyis/ /badz+ra ā lo ke dri'i phyag rgya dang / reg na bsil byed zhim pa'i dri ngad dang / /ga pur la sogs legs par sbyar ba'i chus/ /badz+ra gan+dhe/ gos zung dbul ba'i phyag rgya dang / lha rdzas las grub yang 'jam reg na bde/ /kha dog lnga ldan zung du sbyar ba yis/ /badz+ra wasatra/ lag g.yon mnyam gzhag g.yas nam mkha' la bla re bre ba'i tshul dang / shin tu thags bzang sna tshogs ri mos mdzes/ /rin chen drwa bas brgyan pa'i bla re yis/ /badz+ra bi ta nāṃ/ lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur kha nang du bstan pa'i steng du g.yas pa'i khu tshur yang de bzhin du byas nas bzhag pa dril bu'i phyag rgya dang / tshogs pa las byung stong nyid sgra snyan sgrog /chos rnams stong nyid mtshon byed dril bu'i sgras/ /badz+ra gaṇ+ḍe/ rdo rje khu tshur gnyis kyis rnga yab g.yob pa'i tshul dang / rdul dang tshad pa'i gdung ba la sogs pa/ /sel byed rdul g.yab bsil g.yab sbrang g.yab kyis/ /tsā ma ra/ lag gnyis 'dud pa'i tshul dang / bsgo ba nyan zhing bya ba'i las la mkhas/ /brtson pas 'dod don sgrub byed bran tshogs kyis/ /dā sa dā se/ dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ bsam pa tsam gyis 'dod dgu 'byung ba yis/ /mdzes pa'i gzugs ldan 'dod 'jo'i ba tshogs kyis/ /ka dri ṇi/ 'og nas 'byung ba rta mchog gi phyag rgya dang / mdog sngo rta rgyal brgyad khris rab bskor zhing / /shin tu brling zhing rlung ltar mgyogs pa'i rta/ /a shwa/ glang po'i phyag rgya dang / thal kar mche ba drug ldan rin chen gyi/ /drwa bas spras pa'i stobs ldan glang po yis/ /ga dzaḥ zhes pas phul/ bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/

rdo rje dril bu 'dzin cing / hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ de ha dha ru paṃ pā ra ta ru/ dān+dha liṃ ga ṇa/ yo a dha tu he badz+dza tu haṃ ten+nā hūm̐/ ten+nā hūm̐/ te nā te te hūm̐/ su ra na ra/ wan+di ta/ tsa ra ṇa dha ru/ ku su ma bi/ ṇir+m+mā ma ro ṣa ka ru/ he badz+ra tu hūm̐/ ten+nā hūm̐ ten+nā hūm̐/ te nā te te hūm̐/ bha wa bi muk+ti/ bi she ṣa/ gu ṇa kuṣ+ṇi/ a i/ na ma na ma he/ he badz+dza tu hūm̐/ gu ṇa pī ṭi a i/ zhes pas bstod/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te lag g.yas pas spos phor bzung la/ thugs brtse ba yi dgongs pa can/ /sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol/ /rdo rje 'chang chen rnal 'byor bdag /dkyil 'khor mkha' 'gro lnga bskyed phyir/ /ci nus pa yi nyer spyod kyis/ /slob ma rjes su bzung ba dang / /khyed rnams la yang mchod bgyid na/ /rjes su brtse ba bskyed nas ni/ /bsnyen te bzhugs par mdzad pa'i rigs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pas snyan gsan dbab bo/ /kun mkhyen rin po che dang ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa sogs yig cha phal cher na lugs 'di la bum pa sta gon sngon dang lha sta gon rjes la 'byung ba yang dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi phyag len dkyus ma la 'dir mdzad pas/ gong du bum pa'i gshoms grub na dang ma grub na 'dir bum pa bca' ba sogs gong bzhin rigs 'gre/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li zhes sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa zhes sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang / a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i bum pa gnyis zhabs zhum pa/ lto ba ldir ba/ mgrin pa phra ba/ kha g.yel ba/ mchu 'phyang ba/ lha'i gos kyis mgul 'ching dang dpag bsam gyi yal gas kha brgyan pa/ dri zhim po'i dri dang / bcud rnams kyis yongs su gang ba'i rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa'i nang gi dbus dang phyogs bzhir paṃ las pad+ma dkar dmar 'dab ma brgyad pa re re/

de rnams kyi lte bar nyon mongs pa la sogs pa bdud bzhi'i ngo bo tshangs pa ser po/ dbang po dkar po/ nye dbang sngon po/ drag po nag po rnams gong nas gong du bkan pa'i snying gar dbus dang phyogs gzhan gsum du nyi ma/ shar du zla ba/ 'dab ma rnams dang phyogs bzhi'i sna tshogs pad+ma'i gdan gyi steng du/ zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / ro'i gdan/ las thams cad pa'i bum par sna tshogs pad ma dang nyi ma'i gdan dang bcas par gyur/ gtso bo lnga'i gdan gyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi mtshan bzang po sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi ngo bo a ā sogs nas/ aṃ āḥbar phrag gnyis brjod/ zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor lngar gyur pa ni me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de rnams kyi steng du sangs rgyas kyi dpe byad bzang po brgyad cu'i ngo bo/ ka kha ga gha nga / sogs nas/ ya ra la wa ḍa dha bar lan gnyis brjod/ bsdu na gtso bo yab yum rnams rdo rje cho ga gsum las bskyed kyang rung gsungs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor lngar gyur pa ni mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ dbus kyi nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar du hūm̐ las mām̐ las rdo rje dang gri gug hūm̐ dang mām̐ gyis mtshan pa/ shar gyi nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar du oṃ dang lām̐ las 'khor lo dang gri gug oṃ lam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ lho'i nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar du trām̐ dang tam̐ las rin po che dang gri gug trām̐ dang tām̐ gyis mtshan pa/ nub kyi nyi zla kha sbyor gyi nang du oṃ dang pam̐ las pad+ma dang gri gug oṃ dang pam̐ gyis mtshan pa/ byang gi nyi zla kha sbyor gyi bar du khām̐ dang tām̐ las ral gri dang gri gug khām̐ dang tāṃ gyis mtshan pa rnams so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ de rnams ro gcig tu 'dres pa bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes kyi ngo bo dbus su rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog dbang po sngon po lta bu zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhi pa/

rtsa ba'i zhal sngo/ g.yas dkar g.yon dmar/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na glang po che/ rta/ bong bu zhes sogs nas/ sbyor ba bar/ shar du rtag pa sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar zhing rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na rma bya/ ma he/ chu srin ma ka ra zhes sogs nas/ sbyor ba bar/ lhor rin chen rgyal po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu rtsa ba'i zhal ser/ g.yas nag g.yon dmar ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na bya ka ran+da/ ngur pa/ lug zhes sogs nas/ sbyor ba bar/ nub tu rta mgrin sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba rtsa ba'i zhal dmar/ g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na dom/ bya rgod/ bse zhes sogs nas/ sbyor ba bar/ byang du rta mchog in+d+ra nī la ltar ljang ba rtsa zhal rta'i gdong pa can ljang khu g.yas nag g.yon dkar ba/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na gza' lhag phur bu/ mjug ring zhes sogs nas/ sbyor ba bar/ thams cad kyi steng zhal nas/ yab yum thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /bar mdun bskyed bzhin/ yum rnams kyi mkha' mi dmigs te zhes sogs nas/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ rdo rje'i lam nas so so'i yum gyi mkhar thig le brgyad brgyad dang / slar yang mā ma ki'i mkhar thig le lnga dang bcas par gyur/ de rnams gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐/ pam̐ sam̐ bam̐ ām̐ pam̐ dham̐ dām̐ gham̐/ sam̐ dam̐ tam̐ tām̐ lam̐ ham̐ gam̐ nām̐/ pam̐ dham̐ s+pham̐ sham̐ wam̐ bam̐ mam̐ lam̐/ tam̐ kam̐ kam̐ sam̐ lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tām̐ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhūm̐ rnams su gyur/ de rnams so so'i 'khor gyi lha mo bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang bcas pa rnams su gyur te/ de rnams yum gyi mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i gdan rnams dang las thams cad pa'i bum par gdan gyi steng du 'khod pa ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi 'dab ma la gau rī dkar mo g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin pa de bzhin du/

lhor tsau rī nas/ rlung gis bskyod pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin pa bar dang / de bzhin/ phan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi 'dab ma la skam pa nag mo g.yas skam pa 'dzin pa de bzhin du/ lhor zhags pa ma nas/ dri'i dung chos 'dzin pa bar de bzhin/ rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi 'dab ma la nyi lag ma dkar mo g.yas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin pa de bzhin du/ lhor mar me ma nas/ g.yas gar gyi tshul byed pa bar/ de bzhin/ pad+ma gar dbang gi dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi 'dab ma la pad+ma can dkar mo g.yas pad+ma 'dzin pa de bzhin/ lhor chos 'byung ma nas/ g.yas rdza rnga 'dzin pa bar/ de bzhin/ rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi 'dab ma sgo lcags ma dkar mo g.yas sgo lcags 'dzin pa de bzhin/ lhor lde kyog ma nas/ g.yas ut+pa la 'dzin pa bar/ de bzhin phyogs bzhi'i shar du nas/ dril bu 'dzin pa bar/ de thams cad kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis nas/ gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /bar bdag mdun sogs su bshad pa ltar brjod/ las bum du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas sna tshogs rdo rje g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ stag dang sbrul dang / mi sdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang gis bzhugs pa bskyed/ rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas mkha' 'gro lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khāṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nī wi ti hūm̐ swāhā zhes sogs chu bzhi dang / oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī zhes sogs sngags phyag rgya bzhi'i dgug gzhug sogs bya/ de rnams kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang bskur gyi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga/

yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu/ 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khāṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nī wi ti hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ bar gong bzhin/ bcom ldan de bzhin nas/ lcags sgrog ma la 'od dpag med bar bdag mdun skabs bshad pa ltar dang / dril bu ma dang bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khāṃ swāhā/ zhes sogs nas/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ bar/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi ta sogs brjod/ hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ ām̐ khām̐ mām̐ lam̐ ram̐ pam̐ tām̐ gam̐ tsam̐ bam̐ gham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐ pam̐ sām̐ bam̐ ām̐ pam̐ dham̐ dām̐ gham̐/ sam̐ dam̐ ram̐ tam̐ lam̐ ham̐ gām̐ nām̐/ pam̐ dham̐ s+pham̐ sham̐ wam̐ bām̐ lam̐ mam̐/ tam̐ kam̐ kam̐ pam̐ lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tām̐/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥhūm̐/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas nang mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin zhes sogs nas/ 'khyud pa nyid bar/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs nas/ dgyes bar/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra nges sgrogs shing / /bgegs rnams ma lus 'joms mdzad pa/ /dngos grub ma lus stsol ba'i lha/ /bgegs kyi dgra la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /zhes pas bstod la/ pad kor byas nas gzungs thag blangs te/ bdag gi snying kha nas sngags kyi 'phreng ba dmar po gzungs thag la brten te song nas bum nang gi lha rnams la phog pas lha rnams dmar lam song ste bdag gi dbang du 'dus shing ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung bas bum pa gang bar gyur/ zhes pas gzungs thag nas bzung ste gtso bo'i sngags/ oṃ dha ra dha ra/ dha ra ya dha ra ya/ mar+dha mar+dha badz+ra dhṛka phaṭa swāhā/ brgya rtsa brgyad dang / gzhan ji ltar nus pa dang /

ltag pa nyi ma gar dbang rta mchog gtso 'khor rnams kyi sngags sgrub thabs bzhin/ las bum la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa brgya rtsa brgyad bzlas te dung chos kyi chu thog mar rnam rgyal de nas las bum du blug ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bum pa'i lha rnams 'od du zhu ba las byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin gyi chur gyur/ ces brjod la ye shes pa'i ngo bo rnam pa byang chub sems kyi chu la slar yang sngar ltar mchod bstod byas la/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sogs nas/ ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥhūm̐/ zhes pa'i bar gyis yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskang ngo / /mdun bskyed la gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ gtor ma gong du bar phud nas bran dus sbyang bdug zin pas 'dir mi dgos/ la nang mchod chu chang gis bran te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bgegs bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las zhes sogs nas/ bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur zhes brjod/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ ha ho hrīḥlan gsum/ mdun bskyed kyi dur khrod brgyad du hūm̐ brgyad yongs su gyur pa las shar du brgya byin/ lhor gshin rje/ nub tu chu lha/ byang du gnod sbyin/ shar lhor me lha/ lho nub tu srin po/ nub byang du rlung lha/ byang shar du dbang ldan te thams cad kyang sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang g.yon dril bu 'dzin pa/ rang dang 'dra ba'i rigs ma la 'khyud pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang bas bzhugs pa/ dbang ldan gyi dur khrod kyi steng gi char chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su sku rdo rje/ shar du dbang phyug chen po/ lhor lha'i dbang po/ nub tu tshangs pa/ byang du khyab 'jug shar lhor 'dod pa'i dbang phyug lho nub tu tshogs kyi bdag po/ nub byang du bh+ring gi ri ti/

byang shar du gzhon nu karti kā ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang zhes sogs nas/ bzhugs pa bar/ srin po'i dur khrod kyi 'og gi char chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la āḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las/ dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu/ lhor dung skyong / nub tu mtha' yas/ byang du nor rgyas/ shar lhor 'jog po/ lho nub tu rigs ldan/ nub byang du pad+ma/ byang shar du pad+ma chen po ste thams cad kyang sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje dang / zhes sogs dang / bzhugs pa bar mgron dgug pa ni/ steng gi lha thams cad lha chen brgyad la thim/ sa 'og na gnas pa thams cad klu chen brgyad la thim ste de dag dang gnyis su med par gyur/ mgron byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs lcags kyu la sogs pa'i phyag rgya bya zhing / oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka wāk+ka tsit+ta/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes sogs kyis dgug gzhug sogs dang / de thams cad kyi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma zhes sogs nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma bar gyis skye mched sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs/ mgron la dbang bskur ba ni/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od zer gyis dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /zhes sogs nas/ g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /ces pas mchod/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun/ /zhes sogs nas/ ṣīñtsa hūm̐ bar/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gyis lus thams cad gang /

chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las/ sku rdo rje lha chen brgyad dang bcas pa la rnam par snang mdzad/ phyogs skyong brgyad la mi bskyod pa/ gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan/ pad kor sngon 'gro'i so so'i phyag rgya la/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ badz+ra nī wi ti hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes sogs chu bzhi dang pad kor sngon 'gro'i rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya'i mthar se gol gtog pa dang bcas/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka sa pa ri wā ra/ kā ya wak+ka tsit+ta/ in+da/ dza ma/ dza la/ dzak+kha/ bhu ta zhes sogs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ bar sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin/ zhes lan gsum mam lnga la sogs pa brjod pas mgron rnams mnyes shing tshim nas ci 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol bar bsam/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis phyi mchod dang / hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ ām̐ kham̐ mām̐ lam̐ ram̐ pam̐ tām̐ gām̐ tsam̐ zhes sogs so so'i sa bon gyi mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gi nang mchod dang / rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs nas/ 'khyud pa nyid/ ces yid byung mchod pas kyang mchod la/ bstod pa bya ba ni/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /zhes sogs nas/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes/ /zhes dang / mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes che/ /zhes sogs nas/ sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces pas bstod/ 'phrin las gzhol ba ni/ dril bu chig brdung dang / lha chen brgyad po 'khor dang bcas/ /zhes sogs nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog /ces phrin las bcol lo/ /de nas gur zhal las mgon mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gzhi bdag sogs kyi gtor bsngo 'khor bcas dang / bskang ba sogs skabs su gang babs byas la tshogs 'khor yod na so so'i phyag len bzhin byas la spyi btab/

srid zhi dpal 'byor sogs rgyun bzhin dang / slob ma yod na sde dge zhu chen rin po che tshul khrims rin chen sogs kyis mdzad pa'i mtshams sbyor bzhin byas la/ rjes chog ni mchod pa rnams kha gsos te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li zhes sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa zhes sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du mchod rdzas rnams hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor 'thung / mchod yon/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri mchog zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas byin gyis brlabs/ pad kor sngon 'gro'i so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du chu lhag ma gsum dang me tog sogs la mtshan sngags rang sngags sbyor tshul rnams mdun bskyed sogs su bshad pa ltar shes par byas la/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes rol mo dang bcas pa'i bar gyis phyi mchod/ hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ ām̐ kham̐ mām̐ lam̐ ram̐ pam̐ tām̐ sogs nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod dang / dkar mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin/ /sogs nas/ g.yung mos sku la 'khyud pa nyid/ /kyis yid byung dang / khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /sogs nas/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes/ /zhes pas bstod/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka sogs nas/ ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥhūm̐ phaṭa yig brgya lan gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/

/zhes pa tsam mam/ gang yang bdag cag las dang po pa'i/ /zhes sogs tshig lhug rgyun bzhin brjod kyang chog pas/ lhag chad kha skong bar mdzad du gsol/ /bar/ de nas khu tshur gnyis kyis mthe'u chung sbrel mdzub mo brkyangs te rtse sprad pa gtsug tor gyi phyag rgya spyi bor bzlog ste/ hūm̐ badz+ra ut+tiṣ+ṭha/ sta gon gyi lha rten dang brten par bcas pa rnams mdun gyi nam mkhar byon te ji srid sang spyan ma drangs kyi bar du brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes brjod/ slar yang pad kor sngon du 'gro ba'i so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khāṃ swāhā/ zhes sogs nas/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐/ zhes rol mo dang bcas pas phyi mchod/ hūm̐ oṃ trām̐ ām̐ kham̐ mām̐ lam̐ ram̐ sam̐ tām̐ gam̐ tsam̐ pam̐ gham̐ sogs nas/ dza hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ'i mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod/ dkar mo ri dwags sogs kyis yid mchod/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs sogs kyis bstod/ chos skyong gi bris sku sogs gtor mgron gyi rten yod pa rnams la thal mo sbyar te/ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol/ ji srid nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i sa la ma bzhag gi bar du rgyal ba rnams mya ngan las mi 'da' bar brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ bye brag tu yang sku gzugs kyi rten 'di rnams la bskyed cing spyan drangs pa'i lha tshogs rnams ji srid 'byung ba bzhi'i gnod pas ma zhig gi bar du brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ brtan par bzhugs nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi mgon skyabs dang dpung gnyen dam pa mdzad du gsol/

oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brjod cing rten la me tog gtor/ rten med na mi gsos so/ /rten med pa rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang / /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /gtor mgron gyi ye shes pa rnams rang bzhin gyi gnas su badz+ra muḥ zhes dang / mtheb srin gyis se gol bya/ dam tshig pa rnams rang la gnyis su med par thim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ go bgo ba ni/ rang gi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāk+ka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wā at+ma ko3haṃ/ dge ba bsngo ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa'i/ /lus can kun gyi bsod nams ye shes tshogs/ /myur du 'grub nas tshe 'di kho na la/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa la 'god par shog /bdag gis dus gsum dge ba ci bsags pa/ /nam mkha'i mtha' klas gyur pa'i sems can rnams/ /bla med theg pa chen po'i snod gyur nas/ /kun kyang rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sa thob shog /bdag kyang sangs rgyas ma thob bar/ /skye dang skye bar gnas bzang por/ /rigs bzang spyod pa bzang ba dang / /grogs bzang bla mas rjes 'dzin shog /tshul khrims dag cing mkhas la sgrim/ /rnam par dag cing rgyud gcig la/ /bskal bzang spyod pas rnam brgyan te/ /thos nas legs bshad ston par shog /mgo bor bla ma'i cod pan bcing / /lag pas thabs shes rdor dril 'dzin/ /ngag tu gsang sngags rgyal po bzla/ /yid kyis zung 'jug sgom par shog /'di nas byang chub ma thob bar/ /bla ma lha dang mi 'bral zhing / /sgrub la bar chad med pa dang / /bstan la bya ba byed par shog /bla med bla ma'i thugs rje dang / /rgyal dang rgyal sras rang rgyal dang / /dgra bcom bden pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog /zhes dang 'og nas 'byung ba'i bkra shis byas la tshom bu mchod pa sogs bsdus te dge ba'i bya bas gnas par bya'o/

/sta gon yongs su rdzogs pa lhag chad nor 'khrul med par bstan zin to// //gnyis pa dngos gzhi ni/ lha sta gon byas pa'i sar/ 'di'i dkyil thang rab gnas can zhal shar du phyogs par bkram/ de'i mthar mchod pa dang gtor ma sta gon gyi skabs las mi nyung ba dang / sngon 'gro gtor ma dang phyi rol pa'i gtor ma/ khyad par du skabs 'dir bdud rtsi'i chu zhes bya ba dam bzhag dang gsang dbang gi rdzas su dgos pa chang la sogs par bdud rtsi'i ril bu btab pa dang / dam tshig gi chu zhes bya ba bum pa so sor bcas na de dag gi chu bsdus pa'am gnyis las med na/ rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu dung chos la sogs par blugs pa dang / mdun bskyed kyi mchod pa la dgos pa 'bras bu dang lcags kyu lnga'i gzugs 'gros kyang bsham/ gzhan dang bla re dang gdug dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / gos zung la sog pas brgyan no/ /slob ma dbang bskur byed na mtshams sbyor bzhin de'i dbang rdzas rnams kyang ma tshang ba med pa 'du byas la/ sang nyin dpon slob rnams gral la 'khod sngon 'gro gtor ma nas bzung yab bzhi po dbus kyi gtso bo la thim bar sta gon sor bzhag bya la/ rang rdo rje can gyi nga rgyal gyis mdun gyi mchod pa rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i nas/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i bar sta gon mchod 'phreng byin rlabs bzhin la/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ 'thor thung / mchod yon/ me tog sogs nas/ rol mo rnams dang bar sta gon bzhin/ bdud rtsi dang dam tshig gi chu dang lcags kyu rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ/ oṃ dh+waṃ dh+waṃ/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ/ lan gnyis te zhabs bsil zhal bsil gnyis la sngags so so dang / 'thor 'thung mchod yon gnyis sngags gcig pa yin/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/

oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ bar sta gon bzhin dang / g.yon pa'i mthe bong dang srin lag sbyar ba'i phyag rgya byas te/ oṃ āḥswāhā/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ swāhā/ oṃ shrī hūm̐ ghum̐ dzam̐ swāhā/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la dmigs la rdo rje'i rtses nang mchod nas gtor te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li zhes sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa zhes sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis nam mkha'i dbyings su sems kyi snang ba las byung ba'i nas/ zla ba dang / nyi ma dang / ro'i gdan re re bar sta gon bzhin/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs kyi sgo khang du gtso bo yab yum du gsal ba'i yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te zhes sogs nas/ mes zhu bar sgrub thabs bzhin/ byang chub kyi sems su gyur pa yab kyi rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa las thig le cha bzhi bcu rtsa dgur gyur/ de rnams mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i mkha' 'gro lnga rigs bsdus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs su gyur pa ni/ mkha' 'gro lnga'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rdo rje mkha' 'gro/ shar du phan pa/ lhor rdo rje nyi ma/ nub tu pad+ma gar dbang / byang du rta'i rgyal po rnams rang rang gi yum dang bcas pa/ rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi shar du gau rī/ lhor tsau rī/ nub tu bai tā li/ byang du ghasma rī/ byang shar du puk+ka sī/ shar lhor sha wa rī/ lho nub tu gdol pa mo/ nub byang du g.yung mo/ phan pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar du skam pa ma/ lhor zhags pa ma/ nub tu dol zlum ma/ byang du lcags kyu ma/ byang shar du me tog ma/ shar lhor bdug pa ma/ lho nub tu mar me ma/ nub byang du byug pa ma/ rdo rje nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi shar du nyi lag ma/ lhor mar me ma/ nub tu rin chen skar mda' ma/ byang du glog lag ma/ /byang shar du sgeg mo ma/ shar lhor bzhad pa ma/ lho nub tu glu ma/ nub byang du gar ma/

pad+ma gar dbang gi dkyil 'khor gyi shar du pad+ma can ma/ lhor chos 'byung ma/ nub tu lcags sgrog ma/ byang du 'khyud ma/ byang shar du gling bu ma/ shar lhor pi wang ma/ lho nub tu rnga zlum ma/ nub byang du rdza rnga ma/ rta mchog gi dkyil 'khor gyi shar du sgo lcags ma/ lhor lde kyog ma/ nub tu sgo glegs ma/ byang du gos 'dzin ma/ byang shar du spyan ma/ shar lhor mā ma ki lho nub tu gos dkar mo/ nub byang du sgrol ma/ de rnams kyi phyi'i shar du lcags kyu ma/ lhor zhags pa ma/ nub tu lcags sgrog ma/ byang du dril bu ma rnams zhal phyag yongs su rdzogs par gyur/ lha rnams mtshan tsam gyis gsal gdab nas/ de rnams yum gyi mkha' nang nas phyir spros te dkyil 'khor gyi so so'i gdan rnams kyi steng du 'khod pa ni/ dbus su rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog dbang po sngon po lta bu zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal sngo/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon dmar/ phyag bcu drug gi g.yas pa rnams na glang po che/ rta/ bong bu zhes sogs nas/ sbyor ba bar/ shar du rtag pa nas/ yab yum thams cad kyang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ rdo rje can gyi dkyil 'khor gyi shar gyi 'dab ma la gau rī dkar mo g.yas rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin pa zhes sogs nas/ skyil krung phyed pa'i gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o bar bdag bskyed bzhin/ rang gi snying kha'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis sta gon gyi lha nam mkhar bzhugs pa rnams bskul/ zhes brjod cing phyir 'brang gi bgegs rnams bskrad par bsam la/ rdo rje gsor zhing / ngag tu/ oṃ dha ra sogs gtso bo'i sngags lan gsum brjod/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khāṃ swāhā/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra nī wi ti hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ sarba saṃ sho dha ne swāhā/

oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥkhaṃ raṃ ma hā ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ oṃ e h+ye hi bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsau rī pra bā+e sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bai tā lī ban+dha baṃ/ oṃ badz+ra ghasma rī wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥ zhes pas dgug gzhug dang / de'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma zhes sogs nas/ don yod grub pas dbu brgyan bar sta gon bzhin/ sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor bstim pa 'di ma gtogs ye shes pa spyan 'dren mi dgos/ nub gnyis pa man la ye shes pa spyan 'dren nas/ dril bu ma la don yod grub pas dbu brgyan bar sta gon bzhin/ de nas thog mar phyag 'tshal ba ni/ thal mo snying khar bcings te yid kyi dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo 'di nyid bdag gi drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa yin snyam du bsam la/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang / /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud/ /ces bya ba la sogs pas bla ma la phyag bya'o/ /bla ma de nyid 'khor lo'i rnam pa yin snyam du mos par byas la/ ye shes lnga yi rang bzhin dngos/ /kha dog lnga yi mdangs dang ldan/ /nyon mongs lnga ni 'joms mdzad pa/ /mkha' 'gro lnga la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bya bas yi dam la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gzhan yang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems thams cad kyang ngo bo dbyer med cing de dag kyang dkyil 'khor la tshang ba yin snyam du bsam la/ 'di gsar brtsams phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / /dam chos dge 'dun ji snyed la/ /bdag dang 'gro kun zhing rdul gyis/ /lus btud pa yis gus phyag 'tshal/ /zhes brjod la phyag 'tshal zhing zhabs la gtugs par bsam la/ de nas phyi'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ chu bzhi sngon du phul grub zin kyang 'dir yang chu bzhi 'bul dgos pa mchod yon gyi yan lag tu bstan cing phyag len la yang chu bzhi bsnam par mdzad pa ltar thog mar lag pa gnyis dku g.yon par rdo rje khu tshur kha sprad la bcings te/

g.yas pa'i mthe'u chung dang g.yon pa'i mdzub mo nas rim bzhin dkrol la/ rnam lnga 'dod skor gyi rjes la de dang de'i phyag rgya so sor bca' zhing / dri med yid du 'ong ba yi/ /lha rdzas dam pa'i zhabs bsil 'di/ /bcom ldan 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bzhes nas bdag la dges par mdzod/ /oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khāṃ swāhā/ zhabs bsil dang / de bzhin du/ oṃ bha ga wān la sogs pa kun la sbyar zhing / tshig rkang dang po dang phyi ma gnyis 'dra ba las/ lha rdzas dam pa'i zhal bsil 'di/ /zhes pas zhal bsil gnyis sta gon bzhin mdun gyi bzed zhal du phul/ de bzhin du/ 'thor 'thung 'di zhes pa dang / ku sha'i chun pos sku la gtor/ mchod yon 'di zhes pa dang / mchod yon phyag tu phul bar bsam la/ bzed zhal nang du blug go /me tog 'di ni bzang zhing dge sogs nas/ wasatra ya āḥhūm̐/ bar sta gon bzhin/ lag gnyis kyis 'bras bu 'bul ba'i tshul bya/ bsod nams dpag yas ljon pa las byung zhing / /dngar ba'i ro ldan 'dzam bu'i 'bras sogs kyis/ /zhing khams 'di dang rab 'byams zhing khams rnams/ /bkang ste dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka pañtsa ḍā ka sa pa ri wā ra oṃ dz+riṃ swāhā/ zhes pas 'bras bu dbul/ nang gi mchod pa ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas bdud rtsi'i dbus nas blangs la gtor zhing / dngos grub 'gugs shing mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i rdzas/ /kha na ma tho med pa'i lcags kyu lngas/ /zhing khams 'di dang rab 'byams zhing khams rnams/ /bkang ste dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /oṃ bha ga wān sogs nas/ sa pa ri wā ra/ oṃ shrī hūm̐ ghum̐ dz+ram̐ swāhā/ zhes pas lcags kyu lnga dbul/ nang mchod nas mchod pa nyi shu pa'i/ ga dza pū dzi te āḥhūm̐ bar sta gon bzhin/ dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/

rin chen sna bdun la sogs pa'i mchod pa dpag tu med pa sprul nas mchod par bsam ste/ gser las grub cing rtsibs stong mu khyud ldan/ /dgra las rgyal byed 'khor lo rin chen gyis/ /zhing khams 'di dang rab 'byams zhing khams rnams/ /bkang ste dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la 'bul/ /oṃ bha ga wān sogs nas/ sa pa ri wā ra/ tsakra rat+na/ pū dzi te āḥhūm̐/ de bzhin tshigs bcad/ sngags thog mtha' 'og ma kun la 'gre'o/ /dpag tshad du mar snang ba'i 'od 'gyed cing / 'dod dgu'i re skong nor bu rin chen gyis/ /ma ṇi rat+na/ phrag dog skyon bral bde ba'i dpal bskyed cing / /gzugs mdzes lta sdug bud med rin chen gyis/ /wasti rat+na/ chos min spangs shing 'gro la phan pa sgrub/ /mkhas gsal yid gzhungs skyes bu rin chen gyis/ /su ru kha rat+na/ thal dkar glang chen stong gi shugs kyis 'gro/ /yan lag bdun ldan glang po rin chen gyis/ /ga dza rat+na/ 'dod pa'i gnas su skad cig tsam la 'gro/ /cang shes sprin gyi shugs 'chang rta mchog gis/ /a shwa rat+na/ nor mang rnam thos bu yi dpal dang mtshungs/ /lha mig dang ldan khyim bdag rin chen gyis/ /gṛ ha pa ti rat+na/ zhes pa'o/ /de dag gi phyag rgya ni lag gnyis 'khrig ma bsnol nas kyang / /rgyab dang rgyab tu sbyar bar bya/ /sor mo rnams bsnol lto sbyar nas/ /mthe bong mthil bkug 'khor lo yin/ /khu tshur gnyis ni rab sbyar nas/ /gung mdzub rin chen 'dra bar bya/ /rdo rje thal mo mdzub mo gnyis/ /gung mo mnyam pa'i tshigs su sbyar/ /bsdams la gung mo myu gu bya/ /mthe bong mthe'u chung so sor bsgreng / /lag g.yas glang po'i sna lta bu'i/ /gru mo lag mthil gnyis pas bzung / /khu tshur gnyis sbyar mthe bong dbye/ /gung mo srin lag brkyang bar bya/ /g.yon pas gos 'dzin g.yas pa ni/ /ral gri 'debs pa ltar bya'o/ /zhes gsungs so/ /'on kyang khyim bdag la nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bya'o/

/nye ba'i rin chen bdun ni/ g.yul las rgyal bar byed pa'i sbrang rtsi dang / /tsha grang gnod pa skyob pa'i pags pa dang / /yang 'jam nyon mongs med pa'i mal cha dang / /dga' mgur rtse bar byed pa'i yid 'ong tshal/ /gang 'dod blta nus bde bar nyal ba'i khyim/ /thag bzang bsreg bcad mi nus 'jam po'i gos/ /chu la mi 'bying ngal dub med pa'i lham/ /nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun 'di dag gis/ /sap+ta u pa rat+na/ yang bkra shis rdzas brgyad dbul bar 'dod na/ lha yi dbang po lha min g.yul rgyal tshe/ /bkra shis lha mo brgyad kyis mchod pa ltar/ /rgyal ba rnams dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /bkra shis rdzas brgyad dag gis mchod par bya/ /maṅga laṃ wasatra dra bya/ 'di dang nye ba'i rin chen bdun la nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bca'o/ /de nas rigs so so la mchod pa so sor dbul bar mos te/ glu ni rdo rje can la 'bul/ /gar ni sangs rgyas rnams la 'bul/ /hi ra mchog la de bzhin dri/ /'jig rten rje la bza' dang btung / /gos kyi mchod pa rta mchog la/ /'di rnams dam tshig dam pas ste/ /rdo rje mchod pa byas pa yis/ /rdo rje can kun mnyes par byed/ /a ka ru nag kyai rdo rje/ /phan pa la ni tsan+dan dkar/ /dmar po 'jig rten rje la dbul/ /kha che rdo rje snang ba la/ /bdun gyi rgyal po thams cad de/ /hūm̐ rdo rje las byung ba'i dri/ /'di rnams dri yis rab sbyor bas/ /dam pa'i sangs rgyas nyid thob bo/ /kha ba tsha ba rdo rjer dbul/ /dngar ba rdo rje rtag pa la/ /skyur ba rdo rje nyi ma la/ /de bzhin lan tshwa 'jig rten rjer/ /rta'i rgyal po thams cad dam/ /ska ba rab tu dbul bar bya/ /kyai yi rdo rje rdor can gyis/ /me tog mdog nag rkang 'thung 'byung / /mā li ka dang ma la ti/ /kun+da rtag tu sangs rgyas dbul/ /shing gi dbang mchog dri med mdog /snang byed la ni dbul bar bya/ /ut+pal dmar mo chu skyes dang /

/be du dmar po pa ḍa laṃ/ /pad+ma gar gyi dbang la dbul/ /rta mchog rdo rje can kun la/ /tsan+dan gnyis dang gur gum gnyis/ /brag zhun de bzhin 'dod sman ni/ /'di rnams rdzas kyi bdug spos che/ /he ru ka la rab tu dbul/ /ka tso ra dang kun ma dang / /de bzhin du yang skra dgra nyid/ /bdug byed snying po 'di rnams ni/ /phan pa la ni dbul bar bya/ /kun tu ru dang ba la ka /ri dwags lte ba sen mo ni/ /rin chen rgyal po nyid la dbul/ /kun la mi 'jigs bu ram dang / /sha thi dri yi sha this dang / /sha liñdza dang shi la ka /'di dag 'jig rten mgon la 'bul/ /sna tshogs la ni dri sna tshogs/ /kyai rdor la ni ral gri mchog /phan par me long de bzhin no/ /rta mgrin la ni gos bzang ste/ /rdo rje nyi ma la ni gser/ /rta mchog la ni mgyogs 'gro ste/ /mchog tu phan pa nyid kyi yon/ /sangs rgyas 'bras bu 'dod pa yis/ /rtag tu rigs rnams dag la dbul/ /zhes brjod/ de nas mchod pa thams cad kyang bsdu na 'dod yon lngar 'dus pas/ de dag dbul bar bya ste/ g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyi steng du g.yas thal mo gshibs te me long gi phyag rgya dang / gzugs la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /mchod par byed pas mchod par bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rnam par snang mdzad zhi/ /rū pa kā ma gu ṇa sil snyan dbul zhing / sgra la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas rin chen 'byung gnas gtso/ /shap+ta dri'i phyag rgya dang / dri la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /sangs rgyas sogs la dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /'dod chags chos kyi 'byung gnas gtso/ /gan+dhe/ ro la rnam gsum shes byas nas/ /lha rnams la ni dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan sna tshogs pa/ /sangs rgyas thogs med rdo rje 'dzin/ /rā sa gos kyi phyag rgya/ reg la rnam gsum shes byas nas/

/las kyi rigs la dbul bar bya/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /mi bskyod pa yi tshul brnyes pa'o/ /spar+she ka ma gu ṇa/ de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa ni/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las gau rī la sogs pa'i lha mo brgyad sprul te mchod par bsam zhing / ngag tu/ dkar mo mo ri dwags mtshan ma 'dzin sogs nas/ 'khyud pa nyid bar brjod/ bla na med pa'i mchod pa ni/ lus mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya dang ldan par bya ste mchod bya mchod byed mchod pa rnams mi dmigs par bsam la/ cung zad cig mnyam par bzhag cing / rdo rje theg pa mnyes byed pa/ /'di ni don dam mchod pa yin/ /gang gis rnam rtog rnams spangs te/ /byang chub sems ni rnam bsgom zhing / /lus dang sems ni rnam dag pa/ /de yi mchod pa bla na med/ /sems can gang gis dbu ma yi/ /theg pa bsgom pa ma bsgoms na/ /theg pa dman la lha mos pas/ /de yi mchod pa kun rdzob yin/ /zhes pas mchod/ bstod pa'i mchod pa ni/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor/ /sogs nas/ he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dgyes/ /zhes pa'i bar brjod/ sems can kun gyi thams cad khyod/ /sdig pa thams cad rnam sbyong ba/ /chos rnams thams cad yongs su rtogs/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sdang bas mnan pa'i 'gror gzigs nas/ /zhe sdang thams cad zad bya'i phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro ba bud med 'dul gzigs nas/ /bdag med rnal 'byor mar gyur gang / /phyag 'tshal pha rol phyin mthun la/ /sgyu ma'i phyag rgyar phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gti mug mnan pa'i 'gror gzigs nas/ /gti mug thams cad zad par mdzad/ /rgyal ba mgon po rnam snang mdzad/ /gti mug rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /nga rgyal mnan pa'i 'gror gzigs nas/ /nga rgyal thams cad zad mdzad pa/ /rdo rje nyi ma rgyal po che/

/ser sna rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chags pas mnan pa'i 'gror gzigs nas/ /'dod chags thams cad zad mdzad pa/ /rta mgrin rgyal po chen po ste/ /'dod chags rdo rje phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro ba phrag dog mnan gzigs nas/ /phrag dog thams cad zad mdzad pa/ /bdun gyi rgyal po rgyal po ste/ /thams cad gzigs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ de wa dha ru sogs rdo rje'i glus sta gon bzhin byas la/ sngar bshams pa'i bdud rtsi'i chu/ oṃ āḥswāhā/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas bdag gi lce la myang bar bya'o/ /'di ni 'og gi gsang dbang gi rdzas byin gyis brlabs pa dang skabs 'dir bdag nyid kyis bdud rtsi myang ba gnyis ka'i dgongs pa'o/ /sgrub g.yog oṃ dha ra sogs rdo rje can gyi sngags bzla zhing dkyil 'khor bsrung du bcug la/ rang nyid rdo rje dril bu dang bcas te phyir phyungs nas/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i sgo drung du stegs kyi steng du rab tu che ba'i gtor ma ba dan gyis brgyan pa bzhag de'i g.yas su chu bzhi dang / g.yon du nyer spyod lnga dang / mdun du thod pa'am snod gzhan gyi nang du nang mchod bshams/ gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis bran te/ mchod pa dang gtor ma byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba sogs nas/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur ces dang / oṃ nī rī hūm̐ zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra shap+ta āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis byin rlabs bya/ gtor ma/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs nas/ ha ho hrīḥbar gtor bsngo byin rlabs bzhin/ gtor ma'i steng gi nam mkhar e e e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum sum brtsegs kyi nang du paṃ paṃ paṃ las pad+ma 'dab brgyad re re/ steng gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la oṃ dgu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su sku rdo rje/

shar du dbang phyug chen po zhes sogs dang / bar gyi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la hūm̐ dgu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su thugs rdo rje/ shar du brgya byin zhes sogs dang / 'og gi chos 'byung la gnas pa'i pad+ma'i lte ba dang 'dab ma brgyad la āḥdagu yongs su gyur pa las dbus su gsung rdo rje/ shar du stobs kyi rgyu zhes sogs nas/ klu chen brgyad la thim bar/ rang gi snying kha'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra gau rī sogs kyis dgug gzhug nas/ klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa la 'od dpag med kyis dbu brgyan bar gtor bsngo bzhin/ oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khaṃ swāhā zhes sogs nas 'khyud pa nyid bar dang / mi bskyod rdo rje ye shes sogs nas/ kun 'grub shog bar gtor bsngo bzhin/ dpal ldan bla ma sogs nas/ 'phrin las mdzod ces bar sngon 'gro gtor ma bzhin/ dril bu rgyun chags su dkrol la/ kalko i riṭa ṭhe a bo lā/ mum+mu ṇi re kak+ko la/ gha ṇa kri pi ṭā ho badz+dza i/ ka ru ṇe ki a i ṇa ro lā/ ta hiṃ ba la khādz+dza i/ gā ḍheṃ ma a ṇā pidz+dza a i/ ha le ka liñdza ra pa ṇi a i/ dun+du ra badz+dzi a i/ tsa u sa ma kats+tshu ri sih+la/ kaspu ra lā i a i/ mā la in+dha ṇa sā liñdza/ ta hiṃ bha ru kha i a i/ phreṅkha ṇa kha ṭa ka ren+te/ shud+dha a shud+dha na mu ṇi a i/ ni rang shu aṅge tsa ḍa wi/ ta hi dza sā rā wa pa ṇi a i/ ma la a dze kun+du ru bāṭ+ṭa i/ ḍiṇ+ṇi ma ta hiṇ+ṇi badz+ra a i/ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra/ /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum spangs pa/ /sangs rgyas pad+ma rgyas pa 'dab 'dra'i spyan mnga' ba/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis dang po yin/ /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/

/'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /chos kyi dam pa skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gnyis pa yin/ /dge 'dun dam pa chos ldan thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyis mchod pa'i gnas/ /tshogs kyi mchog rab ngo tsha shes dang dpal gyi gzhi/ /de ni 'jig rten dge ba'i bkra shis gsum pa yin/ /zhes bkra shis brjod/ rigs su skye dang dam tshig can/ /smyo med kyai yi rdo rje ston/ /bla ma la gus snying rjer ldan/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /lag pas rdo rje dril bu 'khrol/ /zab mo'i chos ni klog pa dang / /btsun mo'i khu ba mnyam zas can/ /skye zhing skye bar 'gyur bar shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med pa/ /gang gi lam gyis grol 'gyur ba/ /de yi sangs rgyas myur thob shog /oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha sarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsa s+ya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de'i tshig slob mas mchod yon gyi chus gtor snod la bskor te lhag ma gtor ma 'gro phyogs su bsgreng la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra satwa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dri ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sha shwa to me bha wa/ hri da yam+me a dhiṣ+ṭha/ sarba sid+dhim+me pra yats+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me/ tsit+taṃ shrī yaṃ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra ma me muñtsa/ badz+ra bha wa ma hā sa ma ya satwa āḥ zhes gur nas 'byung ba'i yi ge brgya pa'i mthar/ zhes dang / lag pa g.yas sa la reg pas/ gtor mgron sgrub khang gi phyogs mtshams rnams su gshegs par bsam zhing / sgrub mchod rjes ma'i nyin/ ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes brjod/ gang ltar yang / oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas rang dang sgrub grogs kyi gnas gsum bsrungs la/

gtor ma rol mo dang bcas pa sa gtsang sar bskyal te/ oṃ dha ra dha ra sogs gtso bo'i sngags bzla zhing rol mo rgyun chags dang bcas pas slob dpon gyi rting mnan ste nang du log ste yi ge brgya pa bzla zhing shong na dngos su dkyil 'khor la skor ba gsum mam bdun la sogs pa bya/ ma shong na 'dod snam gyi steng nas byas par bsam la mthar dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs nas rdo rje thal mo sbyar te/ ma 'byor pa dang / sogs sh+lau ka gcig dang / bdag cag las dang po pa'i rten gyi gang zag tu gyur pas ting nge 'dzin mi gsal ba dang / bying ba dang / rgod pa'i dbang du gyur pa thams cad dang / cho ga lhag pa dang / ma tshang bar gyur pa dang / mchod pa'i yo byad ma 'byor pa dang / nyams pa dang / dkyil 'khor bri ba'i skyon du gyur pa la sogs pa de dag bzod par mdzad de/ lhag chad kha bskang bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab ste phyag bya'o/ /dngos gzhi dang por sta gon skabs su bum pa sgrub zin pas mi dgos shing / gnyis pa man chad bum bskyed 'di rang du mdzad pas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs pa sogs nas he ru ka'i yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang ba'i bar gyi ngag 'don rnams sta gon bzhin brjod/ de nas bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba ni mdun gyi dkyil 'khor mngon sum ltar dmigs la dkyil 'khor gyi bdag po la gsol ba gdab pa nas brtsams te 'jug pa dang dbang yongs su rdzogs pa bdag 'jug gi tshul du blang bar bya ste/ de'i tshe las kyi bya ba thams cad ni gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa zhig gis mdzad par bsgom mo/ /rang nyid kyi mdun du maṇ+ḍal 'bru snod dri bzang rnams 'dus byas te/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/

/oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re ṣe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho 'dzam bu'i gling / nub ba glang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'i chos rnams zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ me tog dang bcas thal mo sbyar nas/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas/ /slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol/ /byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa/ /mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /dam tshig de nyid stsal du gsol/ /sdom pa rnams kyang bdag la stsol/ /sangs rgyas rol mo las byung ba/ /mi ldog 'khor lo'i 'byor par ldan/ /thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu/ /gsang ba chen por 'jug par bgyi/ /gsang ba'i rigs mtho thams cad du/ /slob dpon chen po bdag 'jug mdzod/ /mi ldog pa yi dbang bskur ba/ /skal ba chen po bdag la stsol/ /mtshan rnams kun gyis rgyas gdab cing / /dpe byad rnams dang yang dag ldan/ /sangs rgyas sku ni yid 'ong ba/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol/ /dbang bskur ba ni rmad byung che/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /bdag ni rtag tu slob dpon 'gyur/ /slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo/ /gtso mo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i he ru ka des dkyil 'khor du 'jug par gsol ba 'debs par bsam la/ dngos su rang gis rdo rje dril bu gsor dkrol byas la/ rnam dag slob ma 'di rnams la/ /byang chub sems ni yongs 'dzin cing /

/gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir zhugs nas/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom par 'tshal/ /zhes lan gsum mdzad pas gnang ba byung bas dri ba mdzad par bsam la/ gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag pas/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin pa ru/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed 'dod dam/ /zhes gsung bar lan phul bar mos la/ gsang ba chen po'i rigs dag pa/ /gsang ba yongs su 'dzin pa ru/ /sems dpa' chen po bdag 'tshal lo/ /zhes lan gsum brjod pa ni dam tshig dang sdom pa ma lus par bzung ba yin no/ /bdag gi thog ma sogs nas/ gnas par bgyi/ lan gsum dang / gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de bzhin du ni bgyid par 'tshal/ /ji ltar dus gsum sogs nas/ 'god lan gsum/ he ru ka des rdo rje dang bcas gos dmar po bzung nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nut+ta ra bo dhi a laṅkā ra wasatra pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hūm̐/ zhes smad g.yogs byin/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ zhes bya bas gos dmar pos gdong g.yogs/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ zhes lan gsum gyis chus bgegs bskrad/ ā khaṃ wī ra hūm̐/ me tog lnga'am dgu'i phreng ba gnang / gnas gsum du oṃ āḥhūm̐ bsam la/ de lan gcig brjod/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /zhes dri ba mdzad par/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhes lan phul/ de nas/ oṃ ki li ki li ma li ghur+ṇi satwaṃ badz+ra satwa tsa le yuṃ yuṃ yuṃ swāhā/ zhes gsung zhing lag pa nas bzung ste dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i nang du 'khrid par mdzad par mos te/ de nas/ rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad du gyur/ phyag 'tshal bar bsam la/ oṃ sarba bud+dha pū dzo pas+d+yā nā ya āt+ma nāṃ nīr+ya ta yā mi/ oṃ ā tsar+ya pū dzo pas+d+yā nā ya at+ma nāṃ nīr+ya ta yā mi/ oṃ sa ka satwa pa tri ta nar+thā ya āt+ma nāṃ nīr+ya ta ya mi/ dam tshig spyir sbyin pa ni/ rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas slob ma'i snying khar rdo rje bzung ste/

rang gi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa 'od zer 'phros pa dang bcas par gyur/ sa ma ya satwaṃ/ sa ma ya a haṃ/ phan yon gyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzung la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyi ngas khyod la ye shes gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa grub pa yang thob na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje'i ye shes bskyed par bya yis/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams la ma smra zhig dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ snying khar rdo rje bzung la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs/ /gnyis ka'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ sngon du sgrub pa'i bdud rtsi lnga'i chu la/ oṃ āḥswāhā/ lan bdun bzlas pa myangs la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'thungs shig /oṃ āḥswāhā/ bla ma'i bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag pa ni/ spyi bor rdo rje bzung la/ deng phyin chad khyod kyis dpal he ru ka nga yin gyis/ ngas khyod la 'di byos shig ces gang bsgo ba de bya dgos so/ /khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig mi bde ba ma spangs par khyod dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla zung gcig lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo tha mi dad pa la ye shes dbab pa zhu ba'i yon du 'bul bar bgyi'o+o/ /thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes phul/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis byin gyis rlobs shig

dpal rdo rje sems dpa' bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum brjod la/ rang nyid langs nas yod pa'i snying khar laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rje rtse lnga pas mtshan pa'i lte ba la hūm̐/ mgrin par baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po bum pa la āḥ spyi bor yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor du ba 'khrigs pa la ha/ rkang pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu brdungs pa lta bu chang bzung thur du bstan pa/ mchog ma gnyis gyen du bstan pa la yaṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du rkang pa gnyis bgrad nas gnas pa'i rkang mthil gnyis su dzhaiṃ ljang khu dag cing bzod par dka' ba/ rkang 'og gi rlung g.yos te sum mdo'i me sbar bas/ rkang mthil gyi dzhaiṃ mer 'bar bas long bu gnyis nas zhugs/ sum mdo'i gnas su 'dzom ste drag tu 'bar bas snying ga'i sa bsregs/ des mgrin pa'i chu bskol/ rkang 'og gi rlung gis gyen du bteg spyi bo'i rlung gis thur la mnan te bar snang du yed yed yod par gyur/ de'i tshe gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo yin pa la rnam pa dang po'i rdo rje phra mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs te ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas thim/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ āḥha dzhaiṃ/ a be sha ya satwaṃ bha ya ra ra ra ra/ tsa la hūm̐ āḥha dzhaiṃ/ zhes yang yang brjod pas babs pa de bstan par bya ba'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya pra ti pā li ta hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho hoḥswāhā/ zhes brjod nam mkha'i kha dog bltas la dkar ser dmar sngo ljang sogs gang mthong de'i dngos grub thob par 'gyur snyam du mos/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥ zhes me tog 'bul ba'i ltang ka dang / slar yang spyi bor cung zad bzhag stobs po chen po sems dpa' che/

/'di ni so sor bzung bar bya/ /zhes me tog spyi bor bcings par bsam/ rang gi mig gnyis su oṃ rab tu 'bar ba re re bsgom ste/ oṃ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /mig ni thams cad 'byed mdzad de/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ dzña na tsak+ṣu hūm̐ āḥswāhā/ zhes mig dar 'grol bar mdzad par bsam/ de nas/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu bskyed/ /khyed kyang sangs rgyas rigs su skyes/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs/ /zhes dkyil 'khor la blta bar bskul bas mngon sum lta bur mjal bar bsam la shin tu dga' ba'i blos he ru ka de'i zhabs la phyag byas par bsam nas thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so/ /oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor de ring bdag gis mthong / /oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi/ /dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur/ /zhes dang / dam tshig bzung bar mos la/ sa ma ya ho ho hoḥ maṇ+ḍal nas/ gtso bo tha mi dad pa la rdo rje slob ma'i dbang zhu ba'i yon zhes tshig bsgyur ba tsam ma gtogs gzhan rnams gong gi ye shes dbab pa'i maṇ+ḍal ltar ro/ /thal mo sbyar la/ khyod ni he ru ka dpal te/ /bde gshegs rnams kyis bde stsol mdzad/ /byang chub sems dpa' che rnams kyi/ /yang dag don mchog rnam dag pa/ /ji ltar de nyid bdud rtsi yis/ /dbang gi mchog ni bskur ba bzhin/ /de bzhin bdag la 'khor ba yi/ /sdug bsngal rnams ni bsal bar mdzod/ /rnal 'byor bdud rtsi dri med mchog /ma rig pa yi rab rib 'joms/ /gang gis byang chub bla na med/ /de ring bdag gis thob par mdzod/ /lan gsum/ dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa sgo bzhi pa rta babs bzhis mdzes pa/ 'dod snam pha gu drwa ba drwa phyed mda' yab pu shu la sogs pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'i dbus su seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma dkar dmar 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar bdud bzhi brtsegs pa'i snying gar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang nyid rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku mdog sogs nas/

dbus su bzhugs pa'i bar sta gon bzhin las/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje mkha' 'gro yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs te/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī sogs bzhis phyag rgya dang bcas pas rang la bstim/ de'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma/ oṃ a bhi ṣīñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur te/ oṃ badz+ri bha wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes mngon du byas te/ mi bskyod pa'i dbur brgyan pa'i skur gyur/ de'i steng du bla bre/ g.yas su gdugs/ g.yon du rgyal mtshan/ mtha' skor kun tu dung dang / 'phan dang me tog gi phreng ba la sogs pa mchod pa'i rnam grangs bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba dang bcas par gyur/ oṃ nī rī hūm̐ khāṃ swāhā/ zhabs bkru ba dang / oṃ nī rī tī hūm̐ khāṃ swāhās zhal bkru ba dang / oṃ sarba saṃ shwa dha ne swā hās 'thor 'thung gis sku la gtor/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha ar+ghaṃ hūm̐ gis mchod yon phyag tu gtad par bsam/ bdag gis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad sdig pa'i sa bon kaṃ yig gi rnam pas sna sgor thon pa mdun gyi til la thim/ khu tshur gnyis gyis til blang la/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ya badz+ra sa twa s+ya sarba pā paṃ da ha da ha swāhā/ zhes bzla zhing g.yas dang g.yon gyis bskor la kham phor gyis mer blug de bzhin du khu tshur gyis chu blang la/ oṃ hūm̐ ḍa ḍi ta phaṭa/ ces brjod cing bskor la mer blug par bya'o/ /bdag gi byur dang skal ba ngan pa dang bkra mi shis pa thams cad nye bar zhi bar gyur cig de nas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/

oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes mchod pa lngas mchod la/ bum pa sgrub g.yog gis lag tu blangs te rol mo'i sgra dang gsungs par dril gsil dang dbyangs kyi 'dren pa dang bcas pas/ phun sum tshogs 'dzin gser gyi ri bo lta bu'i mdog /'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po dri ma gsum ni rab tu spangs/ /sangs rgyas chu skyes 'dab rgyas lta bu'i spyan mnga' ba/ /bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir khyod la bkra shis shog /de yis nye bar bstan pa'i mchog rab mi g.yo ba/ /'jig rten gsum na grags shing lha dang mis mchod pa/ /dam chos rab mchog skye dgu rnams la zhi byed pa/ /'jig rten bkra shis gnyis pa deng 'dir khyod la shog /dam pa'i chos dang ldan zhing thos pa'i bkra shis phyug /dge 'dun lha dang lha ma yin dang mis mchod pa/ /ngo tsha dpal gnas tshogs kyi nang nas rab kyi mchog /'jig rten bkra shis gsum pa deng 'dir khyod la shog /dga' ldan lha yi gzhal med khang ni snying por bcas/ /'gro la phan phyir 'dir gshegs dbang por bcas pa'i lha/ /rjes su 'brang ba de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /'dab gsar 'tsher ba'i me tog char 'bab lulbi'i tshal/ /mang po lha yis bsten par mgon po bltams pa na/ /srid pa'i mthar gyur pa yi bkra shis gang lags pa/ /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /sna tshogs skyon rnams rnam par gzhom par bya ba'i phyir/ /dges pas dka' thub tshal du nam phyed mngon par byung / /dbang bcas lha rnams rjes su 'brang ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /chu bo'i 'gram du mchod yon 'phreng bas yongs su bskor/ /zhi phyir ngo mtshar gyur pa srid pa dag byed pa/ /klu yi rgyal pos legs par bstod pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog

/grong khyer mchog gyur ser skya zhes ni bya ba der/ /rmad du grags pa chen po'i lha yis mngon bstod pa/ /bsam yas dge sgrub de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /sems can thams cad la ni phan phyir byang chub pa/ /dam chos rin chen tshogs ni thub pa las byung ba/ /sems can don grub rab rgyas brtson pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /rab tu 'od 'bar gser mdog lta bu'i sku mnga' ba/ /baiḍūr+ya mdog lta bu'i rtswa gdan steng du bzhugs/ /skyil krung legs bcas mi g.yo sku mnga'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /shing gi rgyal po'i rtsa bar bcom ldan byams stobs kyi/ /bdud tshogs kun las rnam par rgyal tshe sa dang mkhar/ /rnam par sna tshogs ngo mtshar gyur pa'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /wā ra ṇa ser bzhugs nas bde bar gshegs ston pas/ /sa dang mkha' la ngo mtshar shin tu gsal byung bas/ /chos kyi 'khor lo dam pa bskor ba'i bkra shis gang / /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /bkra shis gang zhig phan byed dam pa mchod phyir thogs/ /bsod nams bya byed 'phags pa'i skye bos mngon bstod pa/ /bcom ldan thub pa shākya'i seṅges gang gsungs pa'i/ /bkra shis des ni deng 'dir khyod la zhi byed shog /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams spang bya mi thun pa'i phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal nas shin tu bkra shis par gyur cig zhes brjod/ las bum gyi chu dang rang dang rnam rgyal bum pa gnyis ka la gtor la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dha sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ bdag gi rnam par shes pa'i phung po dang / dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang rdo rje can sku mdog in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo ba zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa zhabs bzhis pa sogs nas/

nyams dgu dang ldan pa bar/ de'i pang na yum mā ma ki sku mdog nag mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ g.yas gri gug dang g.yon thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ phyag rgya lngas brgyan pa/ gcer bu zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas bskum pas yab la 'khril ba/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje can yab yum gyi snam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs te/ oṃ badz+ra gau rī ā kar sogs nas/ hoḥ'i bar phyag rgya dang bcas pas rang la bstim/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ dbang rdzas la bstim/ de'i mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma zhes sogs nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma bar/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga yum bzhi/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad/ lha mo drug khro bo bcu 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ sngags dang phyag rgyas sbyangs/ 'di 'og ma rnams la mi mdzad/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag he ru ka'i gzugs su gyur te/ oṃ badz+ri bhā wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes mngon du byas te mi bskyod pa'i dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi rdo rje can yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rnam rgyal bum pa'i chur gyur/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /zhes sogs nas/ ṣīñtsa hūm̐ bar/ zhes gsung zhing rig ma brgyad kyis bum pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang bas spyi gtsug tshangs pa'i bu ga nas dbang bskur/

rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu len/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ rig ma rnams kyis mchod/ khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ dbang bskur ba'i chu rgyun des lus thams cad gang / sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa'i dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ bar/ de ltar na dbang bskur ba lnga las bum pa'i chu'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa lnga las zhe sdang dag phung po lnga las rnam par shes pa'i phung po'i dri ma sbyangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga las mi bskyod par byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes lnga las chos dbyings ye shes kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /oṃ swa bhā wa zhes sogs kyis sbyangs/ bdag gi tshor ba'i phung po dang dbang rdzas dbu rgyan mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ām̐ las rin po che am̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang rin chen rgyal po sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa zhes sogs nas/ nyams dgu dang ldan pa bar/ de'i pang na yum rin chen sgrol ma ser mo nas/ dbus na bzhugs pa bar gong gi mā ma kī bzhin/ thugs ka'i am̐ las 'od 'phros pas sogs/ rin chen rgyal po yab yum gyi rnam par sogs nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma bar/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang rdzas kyis lha'i spyi bor cod paṇa bcings pas rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes mngon du byas te/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dbur rgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi rin chen rgyal po yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas cod paṇa du gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/

dbu rgyan gyon la/ rin po che yi dbu rgyan dang / /dar dpyangs cod paṇa dag gi dbang / /de ring khyod la dbang bskur ro/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung / /oṃ mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣīñtsa mi/ zhes gsungs shing bdag la cod paṇa bcings te dbang bskur bas rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes mngon du byas te/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ bar gong ltar dang / de ltar na dbang bskur ba lnga las cod paṇa gyi dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa lnga las nga rgyal dang ser sna dag phung po lnga las tshor ba'i phung po'i dri ma sbyangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga las rin chen 'byung ldan du byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes lnga las mnyam nyid ye shes kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /oṃ swa bhā wa zhes sogs kyis sbyangs/ bdag gi 'du shes kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dz+rīṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang rta mgrin sku mdog pad+ma rā ga ltar dmar ba zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa zhes sogs nas/ nyams dgu dang ldan pa nas/ de'i pang na yum gos dkar mo sku mdog dmar mo sogs nas/ bzhugs pa bar/ thugs ka'i dz+rīṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rta mgrin yab yum gyi rnam par sogs nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma bar/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la zhes sogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang rdzas kyi lha'i phyag g.yas su rdo rje byin pas rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes mngon du byas te/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi rta mgrin yab yum snyoms par zhugs/ zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas rdo rjer gyur/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/

lag g.yas su rdo rje blangs la/ sangs rgyas rdo rje'i dbang gis ni/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur bya/ /'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /shin tu grub phyir rdo rje bzung / /oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li hoḥ badz+ra wa ra ta ka hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing rdo rje lag pa g.yas su byin pas rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes mngon du byas te 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ bar/ de ltar na dbang bskur ba lnga las rdo rje'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa lnga las 'dod chags dag phung po lnga las 'du shes kyi phung po'i dri ma sbyangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga las 'od dpag med du byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes lnga las so sor rtog pa'i ye shes kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /oṃ swa bhā wa zhes sogs kyis sbyangs/ bdag gi 'du byed kyi phung po dang dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du khāṃ las ral gri khāṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las gnyis ka'ang rta mchog sku mdog in+d+ra nī la ltar ljang ba zhal brgyad phyag drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa zhes sogs nas/ nyams dgu dang ldan pa bar/ de'i pang na yum dam tshig sgrol ma sku mdog ljang khu zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma sogs nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa bar/ thugs ka'i khāṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas sogs/ rta mchog yab yum gyi rnam par sogs nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma bar/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang rdzas kyi lha'i phyag g.yon du dril bu byin pas rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes mngon du byas te don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ dbang rdzas kyi rta mchog yab yum snyoms par zhugs zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas dril bur gyur/

de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ lag pa g.yon pas dril bu bsil la/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣīñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ zhes gsung zhing dril bu lag pa g.yon du byin pas rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes mngon du byas te don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ bar/ de ltar na dbang bskur ba lnga las dril bu'i dbang thob/ nyon mongs pa lnga las phrag dog dag phung po lnga las 'du byed kyi phung po'i dri ma sbyangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga las don yod grub pas byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes lnga las bya ba grub pa'i ye shes kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /oṃ swa bhā wa zhes sogs kyis sbyangs/ bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag gi gzugs kyi phung po rtag pa sku mdog zla ba ltar dkar ba zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa zhes sogs nas/ nyams dgu dang ldan pa bar/ de'i pang na yum sangs rgyas spyan ma sku mdog dkar mo sogs nas/ gnyis ka'ang ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa bar/ thugs ka'i bh+rūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rtag pa yab yum gyi rnam par sogs nas/ thugs rdo rje ma bar/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la zhes sogs kyis gsol ba btab/ rdor dril lhan cig spyi bor dkrol la/ oṃ badz+ra satwa satwaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mī badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes brjod la de bzhin gshegs pa lnga dang de'i rigs kyi ming 'dogs par mdzad par bsam la/
