rang gi gsang ming gang yin dran par byas la/ zhes ming btags pas rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes mngon du byas te rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs nas/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ bar/ de ltar na dbang bskur lnga las ming gi dbang thob nyon mongs pa lnga las gti mug dag phung po lnga las gzugs kyi phung po'i dri ma sbyangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa lnga las rnam par snang mdzad du byin gyis brlabs/ ye shes lnga las me long lta bu'i ye shes kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed la slar yang / dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba/ /gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha/ /chos rnams rang bzhin rnyog med dag /sangs rgyas ye shes blta bar gyis/ /zhes brjod/ oṃ swa bhā wa zhes sogs kyis sbyangs/ bdag gi phung po lnga'i chos nyid la tha mal du 'dzin pa'i rnam rtog mi dmigs te stong par gyur stong pa'i ngang las paṃ las pad+ma dang raṃ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bdag gi phung po lnga'i chos nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal brgyad/ phyag bcu drug pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar/ g.yas sngo/ g.yon dmar ba/ steng zhal dud kha/ zhal lhag ma gnyis gnyis nag pa mche ba gtsigs pa/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhis mdzes pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes pa/ spyi bor rdo rje nag pos mtshan pa/ phyag bcu drug gis thod pa bcu drug bzung ba'i g.yas pa rnams na glang po che zhes sogs rdo rje can bzhin/ nyams dgu dang ldan pa bar/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog dkar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum mche ba gtsigs pa zhes sogs nas/ rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum gyi sogs nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma'i bar dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/

oṃ badz+ra swa bhā wa a bhi ṣīñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes mngon du byas te mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan zhes brjod/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas/ dbang rdzas rdo rje mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las gser sogs las grub pa'i rdo rje tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i lte bar rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum/ steng gi rwa lnga la dbus su rnam par snang mdzad/ shar du mi bskyod pa/ lhor rin 'byung / nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don yod grub pa/ rwa'i 'og gi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la/ shar du spyan ras gzigs/ lhor byams pa/ nub tu nam mkha' mdzod/ byang du kun tu bzang po/ byang shar du phyag na rdo rje/ shar lhor 'jam dpa'i dbyangs/ lho nub tu sgrib pa rnam sel/ nub byang du sa'i snying po/ 'og gi pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad la shar du rdo rje lcags kyu ma/ lhor rdo rje zhags pa ma/ nub tu rdo rje lcags sgrog ma/ byang du rdo rje sgrol ma/ byang shar du skul byed ma/ shar lhor rin chen glog ma/ lho nub tu lu gu rgyud ma/ nub byang du gzhan gyis mi thub ma/ 'og gi rwa lnga la dbus su ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ lhor gtum mo/ nub tu ro langs ma/ byang du 'jigs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sogs nas/ rdo rje lha nyi shu rtsa brgyad kyi rnam par sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ gau rī sogs kyis bstim/ de rnams kyi mig tu sogs nas/ thugs kar thugs rdo rje ma bar/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la zhes sogs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang rdzas kyi lha rnams kyis phyag g.yas su rdo rje byin pas rgyud la bde chen sogs nas/ mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan/ rdo rje lag pa g.yas kyis gsor la thugs kar bzung ste/

'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag na gnas/ /khyed kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung / /rdo rje snying po'i brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa mā ya satwaṃ dha ra yā mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas bzlas lung ni/ gtso bo lnga'i thugs kar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ am̐ trām̐ ām̐ khām̐ rnams kyi mthar sngags kyi 'phreng bas bskor ba rang gi snying khar sa bon rnams gsal btab nas/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung zhal nas thon/ rang gi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar g.yas skor du 'khod/ oṃ dha ra sogs nas/ badz+ra ra ti hūm̐ phaṭa swāhā/ zhes yab lnga yum lnga'i bzlas lung dang / me tog gtor te/ bcom ldan bdag gis bzung lags kyi/ /bdag la nye bar mdzad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyi/ /'di la bgo bar mdzad du gsol/ /lan gsum gyis me tog spyi bor bzhag rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du/ maṇ+ḍal sogs nas/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang zhu ba'i yon du/ sogs gong 'og gi tshig gzhan rnams gong du bshad pa bzhin/ thal mo sbyar la/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /mchod chen ji ltar stsal ba ltar/ /bdag kyang rab tu bskyab pa'i phyir/ /nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rang nyid dbang stegs kyi steng du rdo rje sems dpa'i nga rgyal gyis 'khod par gyur/ phun sum tshogs 'dzin nas/ gsum pa deng 'dir khyod la shog bar/ bum pa spyi bor bzhag la/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi zhes sogs nas/ ṣīñtsa hūm̐/ rin po che yi dbu rgyan dang / zhes sogs nas/ ṣīñtsa mi bar/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang gis ni zhes sogs nas/ ka ta hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti satwaṃ a bhi ṣīñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya satwaṃ/ oṃ badz+ra satwa satwaṃ a bhi ṣīñtsa mi badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/

kye dpal che ge mo/ rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa la'o/ /zhes sogs kyis rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur nas dam tshig gsum gnang bar bsam la rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad las ji skad bshad pa'i rnam pa ltar bsam la/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nyid/ /sogs nas/ hi hi hūm̐ gis lag pa g.yas su gnang bar mos la gsor zhing thugs kar bzung / thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /ces de kho na nyid bstan pa rdo rje'i dam tshig go /oṃ swa bhā wa sogs nas/ haṃ dbang rdzas dril bu mi dmigs te stong par gyur/ stong pa'i ngang las dril bu aḥlas 'khar ba la sogs pa las grub pa tshad dang mtshan nyid yongs su rdzogs pa'i bum par/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma yab dang bcas pa khog pa'i steng gi ut+pa la'i 'dab ma a shar du lha mo sgrol ma/ lhor spyan ma/ nub tu mā ma ki byang du gos dkar mo/ byang shar du nor rgyun ma/ shar lhor tsun+da/ lho nub tu khro gnyer can ma/ nub byang du rdo rje phreng ba ma/ steng gi rwa lnga la dbus su rnam par snang mdzad/ shar du mi bskyod pa/ lhor rin 'byung / nub tu 'od dpag med/ byang du don yod grub pa/ de'i 'og gi pad+ma'i 'dab ma brgyad la shar du spyan ras gzigs/ lhor byams pa/ nub tu nam mkha' mdzod/ byang du kun tu bzang po/ byang shar du phyag na rdo rje/ shar lhor 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ lho nub tu sgrib pa rnam sel/ nub byang du sa'i snying po/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer sogs nas/ dril bu lha nyi shu rtsa gsum gyi rnam par sngags rgyas sbyangs/ gau rī sogs kyis bstim/ de'i mig tu sogs nas/ thugs rdo rje ma bar/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di rnams la zhes sogs nas/ dbang rdzas kyi lha rnams kyi phyag g.yon du dril bu byin pas rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes mngon du byas te dril bu'i lha rnams la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/

'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ /khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu bzung / /byang chub mchog tu rgyal ba bzhed/ /dkrol la dku g.yon par kha gyen bstan du bzung / srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas/ /rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa mchog ni byed pa yin/ /zhes de kho na nyid brjod pa ni dril bu gsung gi dam tshig go /de nas/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la/ /lag pa dag gis yang dag 'khyud/ /rdo rje dril bu mnyam sbyor ba/ /slob dpon gyi ni dbang du 'dod/ /rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma bsdu ba nyid du gyis/ /zhes brjod/ rang nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum rdo rje snyems ma dkar mo lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can gri gug thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad rdo rje 'chang yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra gau rī sogs nas/ wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥbar/ de'i mig tu sogs nas/ thugs rdo rje ma de nyid bstan par bya ste/ 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya dang / srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung / /sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir/ /shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs/ /dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu bskyed/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci 'dod par ni bsten bzhin du/ /rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor bas/ /bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i/ /phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su bsgrags/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/ /zhes pa ni phyag rgya'i dam tshig go /de bstan pa'i yan lag tu bum pa'i chus dbang bskur te nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i gdan gsum tshang ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par rgyal ba'i bum pa thogs te glu dang rol mo dang bkra shis dang bcas pas spyi bo nas dbangang bskur bar bsam zhing /

dbang bskur rdo rje chen po che/ /khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi/ /gnas las byung ba sbyin par bya/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyi chus/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /rnam shes phung po'i sgrib sbyangs nas/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro 'grub par shog /oṃ hūm̐ shrī he ru ka badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa/ gau rī la sogs brgyad rnams kyis/ /chu yis khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /phung po bzhi dang 'byung ba bzhi/ /lha mo brgyad du 'grub par shog /oṃ badz+ra gau rī u da ka a bhi ṣīñtsa/ de bzhin/ tsau rī nas/ ḍoṃ bi nī'i bar la'ang rigs 'gre/ bcom ldan rtag pa'i rdo rje'i chus/ /de ring༞ /gzugs kyi phung༞ /rtag pa'i rdo rje༞ /oṃ oṃ shrī༞ skam pa ma sogs brgyad༞ /chu yi༞ /phung po bzhi༞ /lha mo brgyad༞ /oṃ badz+ra siṃ san+ta she u da ka a bhi ṣīñtsa/ zhes sogs nas/ oṃ badz+ra gaṃ gan+dhaṃ u da ka a bhi ṣiñtsa bar/ bcom ldan rdo rje nyi ma'i༞ /de ring༞ /tshor ba'i phung༞ /rdo rje nyi ma༞ /oṃ trāṃ shrī༞ nyi lag ma sogs༞ /de ring༞ /phung po bzhi༞ /lha mo brgyad༞ /oṃ badz+ra saṃ sūr+ya u da ka a bhi ṣīñtsa nas/ oṃ badz+ra nāṃ nṛ t+ye u da ka a bhi ṣīñtsa bar/ bcom ldan pad+ma gar dbang༞ /de ring༞ /'du shes༞ /pad+ma gar dbang༞ /oṃ āṃ shrī༞ pad+ma can sogs༞ /chu yi༞ /phung po bzhi༞ /lha mo brgyad༞ /oṃ badz+ra paṃ pad+me u da ka a bhi ṣīñtsa nas/ oṃ badz+ra māṃ mṛ taṅga bar/ bcom ldan rta yi rgyal po'i༞ /de ring༞ /'du byed༞ /rta yi rgyal po༞ /oṃ khāṃ shrī༞ sgo lcags ma༞ /chu yi༞ /phung po bzhi༞ /lha mo brgyad༞ /oṃ badz+ra tāṃ ta la u da ka a bhi ṣīñtsa nas/ oṃ badz+ra tāṃ ta re u da ka a bhi ṣīñtsa/ bar de bzhin du/ oṃ badz+ra oṃ aṅku she u da ka a bhi ṣīñtsa nas/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṃ ghaṇ+ḍe u da ka a bhi ṣīñtsa bar/ zhes dbang bskur ba ni chu dbang rgyas pa'o/

/de tsam mi nus na/ bcom ldan mkha' 'gro lnga yi chus/ /de ring khyod la dbang bskur bas/ /phung po lnga yi sgrib sbyang ste/ /mkha' 'gro lnga po 'grub par shog /oṃ hūm̐ shrī he ru ka badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣīñtsa oṃ aṃ shrī he ru ka badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣīñtsa/ oṃ trāṃ shrī he ru ka badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣīñtsa/ oṃ aṃ shrī he ru ka badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣīñtsa/ oṃ khāṃ shrī he ru ka badz+ra u da ka a bhi ṣīñtsa/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas rgyud la bde chen gyi ye shes mngon du byas te/ chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pa gtso bor gyur pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lngas dbu rgyan/ oṃ su pra tīṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes spyi bor me tog gtor la/ rab tu gnas pa dang / oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe sogs nas/ nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ bar/ dkyil 'khor dang lha'i de kho na nyid bstan pa ni/ de ltar na khyod la rdo rje 'chang chen po'i dbang bskur bas phung po dang khams dang / skye mched kyi dri ma dag nas rang sems mi bskyod pa'i ngo bor gyur pa yin la/ rang gi sems rnam par dag pa 'di nyid dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo yin gyi de las logs su dkyil 'khor btsal du med de/ dkyil 'khor zhes ni gang bshad pa/ /yid kyi dkyil 'khor dam pa yin/ /gzhal med khang zhes bshad pa ni/ /sems ni gzhal med khang brtsegs nyid/ /de yi phyi rol gru bzhi pa'i/ /tshad ni mnyam par gyur pa'o/ /gang zhig byams pa la sogs sems/ /thig skud bzhir ni brjod pa'o/ /thig gang yang dag bshad pa ni/ /sbyor bas chos kyi rjes dran pa'o/ /lta ba kun las rnam grol ba/ /ye shes thig tu brjod pa yin/ /rgyan gang yang dag bshad pa nyid/ /tshul khrims sogs kyi sdom pa mchog /dbang po gnyis la sogs pa'i sems/ /rwa ba lngar ni 'byung ba nyid/ /gang zhig sgo zhes bshad pa ni/ /rnam par thar pa rnam pa bzhi/

/rta bab ka ba bzhi po ni/ /yang dag spong ba bzhi zhes brjod/ /dran pa nye bar bzhag pa bzhi/ /kha khyer bzhir ni brjod pa yin/ /sgo khang bzhi ni gang yin pa/ /rdzu 'phrul rkang pa rnam pa bzhi/ /de bzhin me tog phreng brgyan pa/ /byang chub yan lag bdun po yin/ /'phags lam yan lag brgyad po ni/ /ka ba brgyad po zhes brjod do/ /lam gyi ye shes khyad par ni/ /rnga yab tu ni yongs su grags/ /gang zhig do shal bshad pa ni/ /nyon mongs thams cad gcod pa ste/ /kun tu gcod pa'i ngo bo yin/ /nyon mongs 'phrog pa'i drwa ba nyid/ /tshogs gnyis dag gi sbyor ba las/ /'khor lo bskor ba gang yin pa'o/ /nyon mongs phyed ni gcod pas na/ /do shal phyed pa nyid du brjod/ /zhes so/ /de ltar rang sems de nyid ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis phung khams skye mched sna tshogs su snang yang de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i ngo bor dag pa ni/ rgyal ba mgon po phan pa ni/ /gti mug thams cad zad par mdzad/ /rdo rje nyi ma rgyal po che/ /rnam par rtog pa'i rab rib 'phrog /rta mgrin 'dod pa chen po ni/ /'dod chags can gyi byang chub ster/ /rdo rje mgyogs 'gro phrag dog che/ /theg pa gzhan ni rnam par spangs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rgyal po che/ /mi bskyod ye shes 'byung ba'i gnas/ /skye 'gro mi zad mgon gnyer phyir/ /sgrib pa lnga ni 'joms pa'o/ /phung po lnga ni mdor bsdu na/ /sangs rgyas lnga ni rab tu grags/ /rdo rje skye mched nyid dag ni/ /byang chub sems dpa' dkyil 'khor mchog /sa ni spyan zhes bya bar bshad/ /chu yi khams ni mā ma kī/ /gos dkar mo dang sgrol ma ni/ /me dang rlung du rab tu grags/ /gti mug gti mug longs spyod pas/ /gti mug zad pa gshin rje mthar/ /de ni phung po mthar byed de/ /des ni shes bya mthar byed pa'o/ /zhe sdang zhe sdang longs spyod pas/ /nyes pa zad pas shes rab mthar/ /des ni sems kyi mthar byed de/

/des ni nyon mongs mthar byed 'gyur/ /'dod chags 'dod chags longs spyod pas/ /'dod chags zad pa sad mthar byed/ /des ni ngag gi mthar byed 'gyur/ /de bzhin snyoms 'jug mthar byed do/ /nyon mongs kun zad gang yin dang / /de bzhin las kun zad pa nyid/ /sgrib pa kun zad ye shes ni/ /bgegs ni mthar byed ces byar bshad/ /ces brjod/ de nas rjes su gnang ba ni/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /sras dang bcas pa rnam rol phyir/ /rdo rje snyems pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /dga' ston bde bas mchod par gyis/ a/ /sgeg dang bcas pas 'phreng ba 'phang / /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /des ni sangs rgyas 'bral mi 'gyur/ /phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no/ / oṃ/ lus can kun la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyis blang bar bya/ /de yis bde gshegs dngos grub ni/ /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ / gī/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'du ba'i phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du sgyur bar gyis/ / hoḥ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs bsgos pas/ /lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis/ / hūm̐/ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog dor/ /yab yum yan lag tshogs gyur pas/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par gyis/ / bh+rūṃ/ chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas/ /rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba ru/ /sems can ma rig ldongs pa la/ /ye shes sgron mes gsal bar gyis/ / pra/ rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims shes rab ting 'dzin dang / /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bsgos/ / ga zhes pa lha mchod pa'i rjes gnang dang / gser gyi thur ma'am med na rdo rje la bcom ldan 'das kyi sngags bzla yang bdag 'jug skabs 'dir nas mdzad de rdo rjes mig dbye tshul dang /

ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra nai trā ā pa ha ra pa tra laṃ hri praṃ/ me long blta tshul dang / chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /ngo bo nyid med gnas med par/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la/ /sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye/ /a las skyes pa'i dril bu dkrol la/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de/ /nam mkha' la ni mtshan nyid med/ /nam mkha' dang ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal/ /mda' gzhu 'dzin tshul dang / hoḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang rjes su chags par byos shig ces brjod la/ phyogs bzhi dang steng 'og tu mda' re re 'phen tshul byed/ yang me long blta tshul dang / a badz+ra satwa/ rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyogs pa med/ /bu khyod kyis ni snying la zhugs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' rin chen gtso/ /zhes dang / gang yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems 'di nyid yin par shes par gyis shig de nas chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang byin pa'i phyir/ oṃ badz+ra he tu maṃ zhes pas 'khor lo rkang pa'i 'og tu bcug oṃ badz+ra bhā ṣa raṃ zhes pas lag pa g.yas su dung dang / oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe āḥzhes pas g.yon du dril bu dang / as lag pa gnyis kyi steng du chos kyi po ti gnang bar bsam/ deng nas brtsam ste sems bskyed pa/ /tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ /khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med pa/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /sngags kyi tshul gyi cho ga yis/ /skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod/ /de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la/

/phan btags drin du bzo zhes bya/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang / /khyod la rtag tu bsrung bar mdzad/ /ces brjod nas so so'i 'khor los bsgyur ba'i rnal 'byor du byas nas/ ji lta ji ltar 'dul 'gyur ba/ /de lta de ltar sems can don/ /'dod chags la sogs gtsang ba yis/ /sems can rnams la nye bar sbyor/ /lan gcig 'jig rten kun la thams cad du/ /sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba/ /chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /tshig rkang lhag ma gsum kun la sbyar te/ rdo rje'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /rin chen 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /pad+ma'i 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /rjes su gnang ba byin nas/ byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /phyogs kun tu ni 'khor lo ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med/ /kun tu mchog tu rab tu bskor/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin dag /yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong nas/ /sbyor med bral zhing ma zhum par/ /sems can don ni da ltar gyis/ /chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba dang / de ltar na phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag dpe zhing sa sbyang ba dang 'dra/ lam bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba la dbang bar byas/ sa dang po nas drug pa'i bar thob/ brda lnga bsdus rtse mo'i mnan pa/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku rang bzhin lhun grub kyi rten 'brel mngon du byas pa yin no/ /zhes sogs rtogs pa bskyed de bum pa'i dbang bskur ba 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /maṇ+ḍal zhes sogs nas/ gsang dbang zab mo zhu ba'i sogs gzhan 'dra/ byang chub rdo rje sogs gong bzhin dang / bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag 'byung / /ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che/

/mnga' bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs/ /lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis mig ras bcings tshul dang / dbang bskur ba'i gtso bo rnam par snang mdzad dang spyan ma snyoms par zhugs pa'i sbyor mtshams nas byang chub kyi sems dung dang kun+da ltar dkar ba rang gi lce thog tu bzhag sngon du bsgrubs pa'i bdud rtsi ril bu chang ngam zho'am sbrang rtsi la sbyar ba'am yang na nang mchod nas lce la bzhag cing / ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras la dbang bskur bzhin/ /bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro/ /de kho na nyid kyang brjod par bya ste/ 'di ni de nyid bla na med/ /gnyis med yi ge brjod mi nus/ /chos dbyings rnam pa lta bu yi/ /dam pa'i bde ba yang dag myang / /zhes brjod cing rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rtog pa 'gag par bsam mo/ /de nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis gdong g.yogs 'grol ba dang / lag pa g.yon pas chos gos kyi sna seng ge'i rna ba lta bu byas la bzung / g.yas pas rdo rje dril bu bzung ste/ skye dang rga dang 'chi mi 'byung / /'jigs dang mya ngan nad mi 'byung / /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /bu khyod nga yis lung bstan bya/ /'di ltar nga yis lung bstan khyod/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i ngan 'gro las sgrol te/ /kye che ge mo gsang ming dran par byas la/ zhes bya ba yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa sa 'og dang / /mi yul mtho ris nyid du grub/ /gang yang ngas lung bstan pa 'di la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang / dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu byang chub chen por lung ston par mdzad de sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no/ /zhes brjod/ de ltar na bla ma'i lus dang phyag rgya'i bha ga dang gnyis ka'i byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/

ngag gi dri ma dag dpe zhing sa gshin pa la sa bon btab pa dang 'dra/ laṃ tsaṇ+ḍa lī sngags kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang dam tshig sha lnga dang bdud rtsi lnga'i ril bu bsten pa la dbang / sa brgyad pa la dbang bar byas/ brda' mtheb srin e la reg byed gcig 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku rang bzhin lhun grub kyi rten 'brel mngon du byas pa yin no/ /zhes rtogs pa bskyed de gsang dbang ngo / /phyag dang bcas te/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi sogs gong bzhin las/ shes rab ye shes kyi dbang zhu ba'i gzhan 'dra/ gsol btab gdong bcing rnams gsang dbang bzhin/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang rang 'od dpag med du bsgom la/ rang gi sems la mngon par 'tsham pa ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid can lo bcu drug lon pa'i mi'i bu mo mngon par bsam la/ de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin ma'i ngo bor mos la/ de'i lag pa g.yas pa thabs kyis g.yon par gtad de/ lha mo mthar byed dga' ster ma/ /sna tshogs gzugs can brtser ldan ma/ /bzung zhig bzung zhig sems dpa' che/ /bzung bar byas nas mchod par gyis/ /zhes brjod la gtad pa dang / phyag rgya des/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par bu spro'am/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed par/ /bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam/ /zhes dris pas/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang / /khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par cis mi spro/ /bud med rnams la rtag gus dang / /bha ga'i pad+mar 'o byed par/ /bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur to/ /zhes lan btab/ rang nyid 'od dpag med dang phyag rgya gos dkar mor gsal ba'i yum gyi mkha' mi dmigs te zhes sogs nas/ e ka ra so nā tha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ kar+yaṃ ku ru ṣ+wa me/ bar bdag mdun sogs su bshad pa dang 'dra/ gnyis ka'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/

lte bar swā ser po/ brla gnyis la hā ljang khu ste/ de dag ni de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga dang yum lnga'i bdag nyid can du byin gyis brlabs/ thabs 'di la brten nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya'o/ /snyam pa'i 'du shes gsum dran par bya/ phyag rgya de nyid gcer bur byung nas pad+ma ltar gzhug cing / e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di/ /bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /gal te cho ga bzhin bsten na/ /sangs rgyas bsten pa la sogs pa/ /bya ba pad+ma ji bzhin byed/ /bde chen rgyal po rang nyid ni/ /'di nyid du ni rtag tu zhugs/ /blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba/ /de la mchog gi dngos grub med/ /ces brjod cing dbang gsum pa'i nyams myongs yas babs dang mas brtan gyi lta ba la mnyam par 'jog oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gis mig ras phye la/ mtha' rten lam dang 'bras bu'i dbugs dbyung gnyis las dang po/ mchog tu gsang ba dam pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mthong dang rab zhugs pas/ /sdig pa kun las nges grol bar/ /khyed rnams deng nas legs par gnas/ /bde chen theg pa 'di la ni/ /slar yang 'chi bar 'gyur pa yin/ /mi tshugs pa dang mi 'chi bas/ /cis kyang mi 'jigs rol par gyis/ /srid pa shin tu dag pa'i phyir/ /srid pa'i sdug bsngal las khyod 'das/ /srid pa shin tu grub pa'i phyir/ /ston pa mchog tu gyur pa yin/ /zhes brjod do/ /lam gyi dbugs dbyung ba ni/ dam tshig sdom pa grub pa 'di/ /khyod kyis rtag tu bsrung bar bya/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis mthun par gsungs/ /mchog tu rtag pa'i bka' yin no/ /zhes dang / slob dpon smad par mi bya zhing / /bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya/ /spun la smad par mi bya zhing / /sems can rnams la sdug byams dang / /byang chub sems ni spang mi bya/ /bdag gzhan chos la smad mi bya/ /skal med de nyid gtam mi bya/ /bdag gi lus la nges mi smad/ /chos la yid gnyis spang bya zhing / /gdug la byams pa nyid mi bya/

/chos nyid tshad ni bzung mi bya/ /skal ldan sems can spang mi bya/ /dam tshig rtag tu bskyang bar bya/ /bud med nyid la smad mi bya/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /dkon mchog gsum ni spang mi bya/ /rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya/ /rdo rje dril bu'ang gzung bar bya/ /gtsug tor rtag tu bzung bar bya/ /rtag tu sbyin sreg dgang bar bya/ /rtag tu dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya/ /rtag tu bde gshegs rab gnas bya/ /'byung po che la gtor ma sbyin/ /zhes dang / bla ma'i rgan rabs phyag 'tshal lo/ /rtag par rgyun du sngags bzlas shing / /bsam gtan nyid kyang rnam par sbyangs/ /rtag tu slob ma bsdu bya zhing / /rtag pa ru ni bshad par gyis/ /rtag tu sems can bskyang bar bya/ /rtag tu sangs rgyas cher mnyes bya/ /dzam+bha la la chu sbyin cing / /las rnams thams cad yang dag spyad/ /bye ma'i las la mchod rten yang / /mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bya/ /zhes brjod/ de ltar na kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag des myu gu sngon po smin pa dang 'dra/ lam dbang chos kyi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang dam tshig tu bza' bsrung dang phyag rgya la mi smad cing mi 'bral ba'i dam tshig bsrung ba la dbang / sa bcu gcig pa thob/ brda byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya/ 'bras bu chos kyi sku rang bzhin lhun grub kyi rten 'brel mngon du byas pa yin no/ /zhes rtog pa bskyed phyag dang bcas/ maṇ+ḍal gling bzhi zhes sogs/ dbang bzhi pa zhu ba'i sogs gzhan 'dra/ byang chub rdo rje sangs rgyas la/ /zhes sogs dang / lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mig ras bcings/ shes rab ye shes kyi dri ma dag pa chos kyi sku mngon du gyur pa'i brdar dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang rang gnyis ka rdo rje 'chang du bsgom la/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing / /rdo rje snying po mkha' dang mtshungs/

/rdul bral mthar ster zhi ba nyid/ /khyod rang yang ni de yi pha/ /zhes bya ste/ kye khyod kyis thabs dang shes rab rdo rje dang dril bu'i rang bzhin las/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes myong ba de ji lta bu yin/ de ni yod pa dang med pa dang gnyis ka dang gnyis su ma yin pa'i mtha' thams cad las grol la brjod par ma nus pas/ snang ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa/ bde ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa/ gsal ba dang stong pa gnyis su med pa/ 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid de ni zab cing rtogs par dka' bas na phra ba'o/ /mi phyed pas na rdo rje'o/ /thams cad 'byung bas na snying po'o/ /gang du'ang ma grub pas na nam mkha'o/ /mi rtog pas na rdul bral lo/ /de mya ngan las 'das pas na mthar ster ro/ /rtog pa zhi bas na zhi ba'o/ /de lta bu deng khyod la brjod pas khyod kyis ji ltar rtogs kyi khyod rang gis rang nyid la bskyed par bya'o/ /de lta bu'i don de mngon du gyur na chos kyi sku ni de nyid yin gyi/ lam gzhan dang gzhan du btsal bas ci zhig bya/ sangs rgyas gzhan nas 'byung ba yin no/ /zhes bskyed la de kho na nyid la blo bzhag par bya'o/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ mig ras phye/ de nas gzengs bstod par bya ste/ de bas na khyod kyis de kho na nyid rtogs par 'gyur gyis srid zhi mnyam pa'i lam gyi dam pa rtogs na de lta bu mngon par ma rtogs pa rnams la snying rje chen po bskyed la rang nyid 'dam las 'thon pa des gzhan 'dam las 'don pa la spro bar gyis shig de ltar na don dam byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa tshig tsam gyi sgo nas thob/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag dpe ston thog phun sum tshogs pa rang gi lag tu byung ba dang 'dra/ lam mthar thug gi rnal 'byor bsgom pa dang dam tshig tu dgongs te gsungs pa bzhi bsrung ba la dbang / sa bcu gsum pa mngon du byas/

brda mdzub mos nam mkha' mtshon pa/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku rang bzhin lhun grub kyi rten 'brel mngon du byas pa yin no/ /zhes brda sprad de dbang bzhi pa'o/ /gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gyis dam tshig dang sdom pa bsrung bar khas blangs nas/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa zhes sogs 'jug pa'i yon dbul ltar la/ dbang yongs su rdzogs pa thob pa'i bka' drin gtang rag gi yon du sogs gzhan 'dra/ deng nas brtsam ste bdag bran du/ /khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na/ /khyod kyi slob mar bzung ba dang / /cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum brjod lus longs spyod thams cad blos phul lo/ /de ltar bdag 'jug rdzogs pa dang slob ma gzhug pa'i phyir dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang slob dpon dang slob ma thams cad snang la rang bzhin med par shes par bya ste/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir/ /thog ma tha ma med pa yi/ /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin/ /mi bskyod rdo rje bdag grub mdzod/ /kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste/ /dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal/ /mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod/ /nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa'ang khyod/ /'dod chags kun gyi rjes chags pa/ /'dod chags chen po dga' ba che/ /bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod/ /shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /byang chub sems dpa' bdag grub mdzod/ /dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa/ /rdo rje sems bdag grub mdzad do/ /sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa/ /sems can kun gyi snying la zhugs/ /sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid/ /'dod mchog dam tshig gyur pa'o/ /zhes dang /

bden pa gang gis ye shes mchog /shes rab thabs dag dkyil 'khor yin/ /bden pa de yis mgon bdag la/ /khyod kyi 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod/ /chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med/ /bzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung / /de bzhin nyid las nges par skyes/ /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor du/ /gzug brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis dri ma med mthong shog /bden pa gang gi nas 'di bar lan gsum/ gtor bsngo bskang ba sogs nas/ srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma/ grub pa dang slob mar dbang bskur byed na rdo rje dril gsil bcas/ bdag ni gtso bo'i dkyil 'khor du/ /slob ma rab tu gzhug par bgyid/ /sems can don du bdag gsol 'debs/ /bzod pa mdzad de dgongs su gsol/ /zhes gsol ba thob/ dbang bskur dngos sde dge zhu chen rin po che sogs kyis mdzad pa'i mtshams sbyor ltar ro/ /bdag 'jug rkyang pa yin na gtor bsngo bskang ba sogs kyi mjug gi gsol btab 'di mi dgos so/ /de nas rjes kyi mchod pa rnams kha gsos te/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta zhes sogs kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa zhes sogs kyis sbyangs nas bzung / yid kyi dgyes bar sta gon mjug chog bzhin/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ de phyin sta gon mjug chog ltar la/ bye brag tu yang ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor 'di la zhes pas rten mang po yod na/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor 'di sogs bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i zhes sogs rgyun bzhin byas nas/ ji ltar bsngos bzhin 'grub par shog /bar sta gon mjug chog dang 'dra'o/ /de nas bla ma yi dam sogs kyi bkra shis ci shes brjod kyang rung / yang kho bos byas pa 'di ltar bya ste/ oṃ swa sti/ rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang chen bdag med ma/

/stobs kyi mgon po g.yung mo khrag 'thung sogs/ /dpal ldan dgyes rdor bshad rgyud rdo rje gur/ /gsung dang rgya gar brgyud pa'i bkra shis shog /bla chen 'brog mi mnga' ris gsal ba'i snying / /bstan pa'i bdag po sa skya'i rje btsun lnga/ /rim byon mkhas grub spyi dang e waṃ pa'i/ /gur rgyud gangs khrod bla ma'i bkra shis shog /rdo rje can yab bdag ma yum mchog la/ /dkar mo chom rkun ro langs za phod ma/ /sbos mo ri khrod gdol g.yung lha mos bskor/ /zhe sdang rnam dag chos dbyings bkra shis shog /rtag pa'i rdo rje yab dang spyan yum la/ /skam pa zhags pa gdol zlum lcags kyu ma/ /me tog bdug spos mar me dri mas bskor/ /gti mug rnam dag me long bkra shis shog /rdo rje nyi yab rin chen sgrol yum la/ /nyi lag mar me skar mda' glog lag ma/ /sgeg 'phreng glu gar mchod pa'i lha mos bskor/ /nga rgyal rnam dag mnyam nyid bkra shis shog /pad+ma gar yab gos dkar yum mchog ma/ /pad+ma can dang chos 'byung lcags sgrog 'khyud/ /gling bu pi waṃ rnga zlum rdza rngas bskor/ /'dod chags rnam dag kun rtog bkra shis shog /rta rgyal yab dang dam tshig sgrol yum la/ /sgo lcags lde kyog sgo glegs gos 'dzin ma/ /spyan ma bdag ma gos dkar sgrol mas bskor/ /phrag dog rnam dag bya grub bkra shis shog /dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i sgo bzhir dgug gzhug dang / /dbang dang 'bebs mdzad lcags kyu zhags sgrog dril/ /tshad med bzhi ldan sgo ma rnam bzhi yis/ /phrin las thogs med sgrub pa'i bkra shis shog /byang chos ngo bo lha yi gzhal yas khang / /chos brgyad sogs dag 'jigs rung dur khrod brgyad/ /mi mthun yongs skyobs rdo rje'i pho brang sogs/ /snod dag rten gyi 'khor lo'i bkra shis shog /zab cing rgya che gsang chen zab mo'i bcud/ /dpal ldan dgyes mdzad rdo rje'i rtsa bshad las/ /legs gsung thun mong mchog sgrub lam bzang gi
